source: "A few steps more, and our breaths were literally snatched from us by what we saw; so literally that Thornton, the psychic investigator, actually fainted in the arms of the dazed man who stood behind him. Norrys, his plump face utterly white and flabby, simply cried out inarticulately; whilst I think that what I did was to gasp or hiss, and cover my eyes. source: - Added an option to build and link SDL statically into the game binary (the source code is included in the Git repo), with this method there is no need to install SDL dependencies to play the game (or when building the game). By the default the installed system version of SDL is found and used on Linux, and the prebuilt SDL version is used on Windows. Building and linking SDL statically is enabled via the CMake option "IA_BUILD_STATIC_SDL" (use -DIA_BUILD_STATIC_SDL=ON when running cmake to configure this mode). "Official" releases of the game are built with a statically linked SDL, so there is no need to install SDL dependencies to play these versions.
target: - 新增选项，可将 SDL 静态编译并链接到游戏二进制文件中（源代码包含在 Git 仓库中）。这样游玩或构建游戏都无需安装 SDL 依赖。默认情况下，Linux 会查找并使用系统安装的 SDL，Windows 则使用预编译版本。可通过 CMake 选项 "IA_BUILD_STATIC_SDL" 启用静态编译和链接（配置此模式时运行 cmake 并传入 -DIA_BUILD_STATIC_SDL=ON）。游戏的“官方”发行版均以静态链接 SDL 的方式构建，因此游玩这些版本无需安装 SDL 依赖。

source: - Added spell "Subdue Weapons" - learned simultaneously as "Animate Weapons" (very cheap spell which drops all visible Animated Weapons)
target: -新增法术“压制武器”——与“武器活化”同时学会（消耗极低，可放下所有可见的活化武器）

source: - Added spell (and manuscript) of "Light" (illuminates the area around the caster for a number of turns)
target: -新增“光明”法术（及其手稿），可照亮施法者周围区域若干回合
- 新增法术／手稿“召唤生物”

source: - Added Spiked Maces - a weapon with a weight between medium and heavy, and with a chance to stun the victim
target: -新增尖刺钉头锤——重量介于中型和重型武器之间，有几率击昏受害者

source: - Added status effect "Weak" - melee attacks does minimum damage, decreased carry weight limit, cannot bash doors, lower physical status resistance, and other effects
target: -新增状态效果“虚弱”——近战攻击只造成最低伤害、负重上限降低、无法撞门、物理状态抗性降低等

source: - Added the ability for displaying idle animations while the game is waiting for input, currently this is used for flickering the player color when holding an activated Electric Lantern, or randomizing the color of burning tiles or tiles corrupted by Strange Colors - and also for auto-scrolling item descriptions in the (rare) case that they do not fit in the window
target: - 新增游戏等待输入时显示闲置动画的功能。目前用于玩家持有已启动的电灯笼时闪烁玩家颜色，以及随机改变燃烧格或被“奇异色彩”侵蚀格子的颜色；如果物品说明过长、不适合窗口显示，也会自动滚动（这种情况较少见）。

source: - Added tiles for Cultists wielding different firearms (see gameplay changes above)
target: - 为使用不同枪支 (请参阅上面的游戏玩法更改) 的邪教徒添加了图块
- 为大多数弹出窗口添加了标题

source: - Added trait "Absorption" for Occultists - blocking a spell restores 1d6 Spirit
target: - 为神秘主义者添加了“吸收”特性 - 阻挡法术可恢复 1d6 精神

source: - Added trait "Bane of the Undead" - +2 melee/ranged attack damage against undead monsters, attacks against ethereal undead monsters (e.g. Ghosts) never pass through them (although you can still miss in the ordinary way)
target: - 新增特质“不死族克星”——对不死怪物的近战／远程攻击伤害 +2；攻击以太形态的不死怪物（如幽灵）时，攻击不会穿过它们（但仍可能像平常一样打偏）。

source: - Added trait "Crippling Strikes" - melee attacks have 60% chance to Weaken the target for 2-3 turns
target: - 新增特质“致残打击” - 近战攻击有 60% 几率削弱目标 2-3 回合

source: - Added trait "Electrically Inclined" - gives bonus to using Rods, Devices, Electric Lanterns, and electricity weapons
target: - 添加了“电动倾斜”特征 - 为使用棒、设备、电灯笼和电动武器提供奖励

source: - Added trait "Elusive" - A unique trait for Rogues, that makes creatures only remember you for half the normal duration.
target: - 添加了“难以捉摸”的特征 - 盗贼的独特特征，使生物只记住你正常持续时间的一半。

source: - Added trait "Magically Gifted" - +20% skill with all spells
target: - 添加了“魔法天赋”特征 - 所有法术技能+20%

source: - Added trait "Meditative" - applies a status effect which allows the next spell to be cast without spending a turn, and with the cost reduced by 1 spirit point - after casting a spell this state is reapplied again after some time has passed
target: - 添加了“冥想”特征 - 应用一种状态效果，允许在不花费一回合的情况下施放下一个法术，并且成本减少1个精神点 - 施展法术后，此状态会在一段时间过去后再次应用

source: - Added trait "Resistant" - halved damage from fire and electricity
target: - 增加了“抵抗”特性 - 火和电造成的伤害减半

source: - Added trait "Ruthless", which is an upgrade of "Vicious" with even more backstab damage
target: - 新增特质“无情”，是“恶毒”的升级，背刺伤害更高

source: - Added trait "Sage" - This is an upgrade of the "Meditative" trait, spells are also cast at a higher skill level when "Focused", and the duration to regain the focused state is reduced.
target: - 新增特质“贤者” - 这是“冥想”特质的升级，“专注”时也会以更高的技能等级施放法术，并且恢复专注状态的持续时间减少。

source: - Added trait "Silent" - all melee attacks are silent, opening and closing doors does not alert monsters
target: - 添加了“沉默”特性 - 所有近战攻击都是沉默的，打开和关闭门不会惊动怪物
- 新增“坚实精神”特质（此前名为“强韧精神”/“强大精神”）。

source: - Added trait "Summoner" - Reduced cost for summoning spells, and lower risk that called creatures are hostile
target: - 添加了“召唤师”特质 - 降低了召唤法术的成本，并降低了被召唤生物敌对的风险

source: - Added trait "Thick Skinned", which gives +1 Armor Point
target: - 添加了“厚脸皮”特征，可提供+1护甲点

source: - Added trait "Unbreakable" - This is a continuation of "Tough"/"Rugged" (HP bonus, carry weight bonus, etc)
target: - 新增特质“坚不可摧”——这是“强壮”／“健壮”的进阶特质（增加生命值、负重等）。
- 添加特质“恶毒” - +50% 背刺伤害

source: - Added two common monsters (Flying Polyps, Chthonians), and one unique monster
target: - 添加了两种常见怪物 (飞行息肉， Chthonians) 和一种独特怪物

source: - Added unique Flagellant trait "Memento Mori", which raises the threshold of the moribund status to 8 hit points, and increases the duration of the effect by 50%.
target: - 增加了独特的鞭打特质“死亡纪念”，将垂死状态的阈值提高到8点生命值，并将效果持续时间增加50%。

source: - Added unique player tiles for each weapon that the player can wield (39 new tiles in total), thanks YARD and Hal from the IA Discord channel!
target: - 每种玩家可持有的武器现在都有专属玩家图块（共新增 39 个图块），感谢 IA Discord 频道的 YARD 和 Hal！
- 添加武器“S&W左轮手枪”和“温彻斯特步枪”

source: - Adjacent dark cells are now rendered darker than normal cells to make it easier to notice darkness
target: - 相邻的暗细胞现在比正常细胞更暗，以便更容易注意到黑暗

source: - Adjusted Potion of Poison duration so that it's guaranteed to be non-lethal for any non-diseased player character with full hit points
target: - 调整了毒药药水的持续时间，以确保它对于任何具有完整生命值的未患病玩家角色来说都是非致命的

source: - After a certain dungeon level, dart and spear traps can be poisoned
target: - 达到一定的地牢等级后，飞镖和矛陷阱可能会中毒

source: - Alarm traps now emit a sound with "global" range, instead of just a "loud" sound (although creatures with short hearing range such as Worm Masses still need to be very near to hear the sound).
target: - 警报陷阱现在发出“全局”范围内的声音，而不仅仅是“响亮”的声音 (尽管蠕虫质量等听力范围较短的生物仍然需要非常接近才能听到声音)。

source: - All active properties are printed with descriptions on the [@] character decsription page, and when [v]iewing monsters
target: - 所有生效中的属性都会在 [@] 角色说明页中显示说明；按 [v] 查看怪物时也会显示。

source: - All backgrounds (classes) now have ranged attack bonus vs unaware targets (not just Rogues)
target: - 所有背景（职业）现在对未察觉目标都有远程攻击加成（此前只有盗贼有此加成）。

source: - All backgrounds can learn spells, but the Occultist gains proficiency much faster (and as before, starts with a few spells and has access to unique spell casting traits)
target: - 所有背景都可以学习法术，但神秘主义者的熟练程度要快得多 (和以前一样，从几个法术开始，可以获得独特的法术施法特质)

source: - All creatures have a certain amount of Spirit. If a creature's Spirit is depleted, it dies (monsters may sometimes attempt to cast a spell that could kill it, if it "feels desperate").
target: - 所有生物都有一定数量的精神。如果生物的灵魂耗尽，它就会死亡 (怪物有时会尝试施放可以杀死它的咒语，如果它“感到绝望”)。

source: - All fonts have been replaced with new ones (the reason for this is that the origins and license information of the previous ones was unknown - now this information is clearly listed in a font license text file distributed with the game)
target: - 所有字体均已替换为新字体 (原因是以前的来源和许可证信息未知-现在这些信息清楚地列在随游戏分发的字体许可证文本文件中)

source: - All items which gave XP on identification now instead gives XP when that item is found for the first time (except "Strange Devices") - the reason for this is to reduce the pressure to identify consumables as soon as possible, and also to have a more "natural" continuous stream of XP, rather than occasional bursts
target: - 所有在识别时给出 XP 的物品现在在第一次找到该物品时给出 XP (“奇怪的设备”除外) - 这样做的原因是为了减轻尽快识别消耗品的压力，并且也有一个更“自然”的连续 XP 流，而不是偶尔的爆发

source: - All magic traps now have an effect when triggered by a monster (previously most of them would not do anything at all).
target: - 现在，所有魔法陷阱在被怪物 (以前，他们中的大多数根本不会做任何事情) 触发时都会产生效果。

source: - All Manuscripts are guaranteed to be identified when read (previously this only applied to potions)
target: - 所有稿件在阅读时保证被识别 (以前这只适用于药水)

source: - All menus can now be scrolled with vi keys ("j"/"k"), and the currently marked menu entry can be selected with "l" (these three keys never occur as letter indexes in menus)
target: - 所有菜单现在都可用 vi 键（“j”/“k”）滚动，并可按“l”选择当前标记的条目（这三个按键不会用作菜单条目的字母索引）。

source: - All menus have shortcut keys (either with "(Y)es (N)o" style, or "a) b) c) ...")
target: - 所有菜单都有快捷键（“(Y)es (N)o”样式，或“a）b）c）...”）

source: - All monsters have slightly higher hit chance
target: - 所有怪物的命中率略高

source: - All monsters of the "Reanimated" variety spawn a level earlier.
target: - 所有“复活”类型的怪物都会提前一个等级生成。

source: - All Potions are now guaranteed to identify when you drink them
target: - 现在保证所有药水都能在你喝下时被识别

source: - Alternative commands for diagonal movement (PgUp/Home/End/PgDwn -- or -- arrow keys + shift/ctrl)
target: - 新增斜向移动的替代按键：上翻页／主页／末页／下翻页键，或方向键加 Shift／Ctrl。

source: - And many more minor bug fixes...
- Animated weapons are stronger, but are permanently destroyed when "killed"
target: - 动画武器更强大，但在“被杀”时会被永久摧毁

source: - Any melee weapon can now be thrown
target: - 现在可以投掷任何近战武器
- 装甲 (到目前为止有点粗糙)

source: - Armor disappears when dropping to 0 protection value
target: - 防护值降至0时护甲消失

source: - Armor durability % is no longer shown in the interface (only the protection value)
target: - 装甲耐久%不再显示在界面(仅保护值)中

source: - Attacking a monster in melee with a ranged weapon causes a warning prompt (can be turned off in the options menu)
target: - 使用远程武器攻击近战怪物会导致警告提示(可以在选项菜单中关闭)

source: - Attacking a monster that is delayed by moving into liquid no longer allows them to act immediately.
target: - 攻击因进入液体而延迟的怪物不再让他们立即行动。

source: - Attacking an unaware monster in melee makes it aware even if you miss
target: - 在近战中攻击不知情的怪物，即使你失手，它也会意识到
- 徒手攻击会导致拳击攻击

source: - Available font images are no longer hard coded in the game, instead the gfx/fonts/ directory is searched for any .png file that starts with <width>x<height> (e.g. "7x13_uushi.png"). So new .png fonts can be added just by dropping them in the fonts directory.
target: - 字体图像不再硬编码在游戏中，游戏会搜索 gfx/fonts/ 目录下以 <width>x<height> 开头的 .png 文件（例如 "7x13_uushi.png"）。因此，只要把新的 .png 字体放进该目录即可添加字体。

source: - Backstabbing ("You stab the Cultist covertly with a dagger")
target: - 背刺 (“你用匕首偷偷地捅了邪教徒一刀”)

source: - Bashing now works in a more general way. You can attempt to find secret doors by bashing on any wall. You can destroy corpses by bashing them. Bashing/kicking now always consumes a turn, whether you hit something or not ("I kick the air!"). When attempting to kick in a cell with an unseen monster (due to blindness or monster hiding), it will behave in the same way as normal melee attacks ("I kick it") - this fixes a bug where an attempt to kick an unseen monster had no effect
target: - 猛击现在适用于更多情形。你可以猛击任意墙壁来尝试寻找暗门，也可以猛击尸体将其摧毁。猛击或踢击现在总会消耗一个回合，无论是否击中目标（“我踢了个空！”）。如果你试图踢击一个有隐形怪物的格子（可能是因为失明或怪物藏了起来），动作会像普通近战攻击一样处理（“我踢中了它”）。这修复了踢击隐形怪物时毫无效果的错误。

source: - Becoming aware of the player by looking counts as an action for monsters (to give the monsters some reaction time instead of attacking instantly), though you may still be gunned down instantly if you alert the monsters beforehand (e.g. by making noise)
target: - 通过观察来了解玩家对怪物来说算作一个动作 (给怪物一些反应时间，而不是立刻攻击)，尽管如果你事先提醒怪物，你仍然可能会立即被枪杀 (例如：制造噪音)

source: - Being Blessed/Cursed affects the shock cost of casting spells, instead of the spirit cost
target: - 受祝福或诅咒现在会影响施法的震慑消耗，而非精神值消耗。

source: - Being blind no longer immediately raises shock by 30% - instead the shock ramps up each turn up to 30%
target: - 失明不再立即将震动提高 30% - 相反，震动会每回合提升至 30%

source: - Being Confused now prevents spell casting
- Being Frenzied allows waiting in place (with "5" or ".")
target: - 疯狂允许原地等待 (带有“5”或“。”)

source: - Being stuck in mud had a limited time duration - it now has indefinite duration (the player/creature has to actively pull themselves free).
target: - 陷在泥中的持续时间原本有限，现在改为无限；玩家或生物必须主动挣脱。
- 敏捷性带来更好的闪避机会

source: - Better formula for chances to study scrolls (smoother increase)
target: - 更好的学习卷轴 (更平稳的增加) 机会的公式

source: - Better rules for if player with phobia is considered to be in open or cramped spaces
target: - 对于患有恐惧症的玩家是否被认为处于开放或狭窄空间的更好规则

source: - Blindness affects messages - "It bites you!", "You hear gunfire." et c
target: - 失明会影响信息 - “它咬你！”，“你听到枪声。” ETC

source: - Bloated Corpse spit attack now does acid damage
target: - 肿胀的尸体吐口水攻击现在会造成酸伤害

source: - Blue colors are brighter for better visibility
target: - 蓝色更明亮，能见度更好

source: - Braziers have a subtle flicker effect, similar to the player when using the Electric Lantern.
target: - 火盆有微妙的闪烁效果，类似于玩家使用电灯笼时的效果。

source: - Braziers light up cells around them, and can be kicked over to do fire damage in a small area (similar to a small molotov explosion)
target: - 火盆会照亮周围的地图格，也可以踢翻，在小范围内造成火焰伤害（类似小型燃烧瓶爆炸）。

source: - Brighter interface color scheme (some menus could be difficult to read before)
target: - 更明亮的界面配色方案(有些菜单之前可能很难阅读)

source: - Brown Jenkin now does more melee damage, has very high sneak skills, and knows the teleport spell
target: - 布朗·詹金现在可以造成更多的近战伤害，具有非常高的潜行技能，并且知道传送咒语

source: - Bumping a stuck door now automatically tries to bash it (no need to press "w" first)
target: - 碰撞卡住的门现在会自动尝试撞击它 (无需先按“w”)

source: - Bumping an unseen monster (sneaking or invisible) that you are unaware of no longer performs a melee attack, instead it prints a message such as "There is someone here!", and makes you aware of the monster (you see it as a "!" on the map)
target: - 撞上自己尚未察觉的怪物（潜行或隐形）时，不再发动近战攻击，而会显示“这里有人！”之类的消息，并让你察觉该怪物（地图上会显示“！”）。

source: - Burning features only hurt creatures on the same cell (not adjacent to it)
target: - 燃烧功能只会伤害同一单元格 (不相邻) 上的生物

source: - Burning monsters lights up a small area of darkness around them
target: - 燃烧的怪物照亮了它们周围的一小片黑暗区域

source: - Burning no longer completely prevents reading manuscripts or casting spells - instead there is a 50% chance to fail (wasting the manuscript or spirit upon failure)
target: - 燃烧不再完全阻止阅读手稿或施展法术 - 相反，有 50% 的机会失败 (在失败时浪费手稿或精神)

source: - By default, selecting a menu entry with a letter key only jumps to that location, and a second press (or enter) is required to select it. This behavior only happens in menus that have descriptions for the different entries. Added an option to always immediately select entries when pressing letter keys (the old way).
target: - 默认情况下，使用字母键选择菜单项只会跳转到该位置，需要再按 (或输入) 才能选择它。此行为仅发生在具有不同条目描述的菜单中。添加了一个选项，以便在按字母键 (传统方式) 时始终立即选择条目。

source: - By default, the game runs in fullscreen, using the 7x13 font, and tries to set an appropriate video scale factor (e.g. 2x for 1920x1080).
target: - 默认情况下，游戏以全屏运行，使用 7x13 字体，并尝试设置适当的视频比例因子 (例如， 1920x1080为2x)。

source: - Byakhee spawn from level 8 instead of 6, and can only spawn in groups from level 10.
target: - 拜亚基现在从第 8 层起生成（此前为第 6 层），并且只有从第 10 层起才会成群出现。

source: - Cancellation commands in some places where they were missing
target: - 取消一些缺少的地方的命令

source: - Carrying a lit flare lights up darkness around you, and you can walk around and fight while holding it
target: - 携带照明弹可以照亮周围的黑暗，拿着它可以四处走动并进行战斗

source: - Casting spells can occasionally trigger random chaotic side effects, typically affecting the surrounding area (for example walls may appear or disappear, statues knocked over, etc)
target: - 施展法术偶尔会触发随机混乱的副作用，通常会影响周围区域(例如，墙壁可能会出现或消失，雕像可能会倒塌等)

source: - Casting spells from manuscripts drained spirit points
target: - 从手稿中施放咒语会耗尽精神点

source: - Casting spells while adjacent to an altar allows casting at one skill level higher (stacks with casting from manuscripts)
target: - 在祭坛附近施展法术可以以高一级的技能等级施展 (手稿铸件堆栈)

source: - Chances for scrolls and potions spawning is a bit higher
target: - 卷轴和药水生成的几率更高一些

source: - Changed "Manuscript of Clairvoyance" to a Potion, and instead of continuously revealing monsters and dungeon layout around you, it now instantly reveals the layout of the whole level (including items, but not monsters)
target: - 将“千里眼手稿”改为药水，不再是不断地揭示你周围的怪物和地下城布局，而是立即揭示整个关卡的布局(包括物品，但不包括怪物)

source: - Changed "Manuscript of Descent" to a potion
- Changed "Potion of Clairvoyance" to a manuscript, and gave it a new effect
target: - 将“千里眼药水”改为手稿，并赋予其新效果

source: - Changed API from SDL to SFML - The game should run much smoother on most systems
target: - 将 API 从 SDL 更改为 SFML - 游戏应该在大多数系统上运行得更流畅

source: - Changed color of grates to gray, to clarify that they are made of metal (and not wood)
target: - 将格栅的颜色更改为灰色，以表明它们是由金属 (而不是木材) 制成的

source: - Changed command for bashing/kicking to [q] instead of [b]
target: - 猛击／踢击命令从 [b] 改为 [q]。

source: - Changed command for unloading/picking up ammo to [G] instead of [u]
target: - 卸下／拾取弹药的命令从 [u] 改为 [G]。

source: - Changed command for viewing descriptions to [v] instead of [l] (lowercase L)
target: - 将查看描述的命令更改为 [v] 而不是 [l] (小写L)

source: - Changed Control Object max distance from 2/4/6 to 3/4/5 (for basic/exptert/master).
target: - “控制物体”法术的最大距离由 2/4/6 格调整为 3/4/5 格（基础/专家/大师级）。

source: - Changed equipment screen command (wear, wield) from 'v' to 'w' (more traditional/intuitive key)
target: - 装备界面中的穿戴／持握命令从 'v' 改为 'w'（后者是更传统、更直观的按键）。

source: - Changed healing back so you spend a number of turns to apply first aid (instead of healing at stairs)
target: - 改变治疗回来，这样你就可以花很多回合来进行急救 (而不是在楼梯上愈合)

source: - Changed Inventory key to [i] instead of [w]
target: - 物品栏快捷键改为 [i]，不再使用 [w]。

source: - Changed Potion of Antidote to Potion of Curing, which acts like a light version of Potion of Healing
target: - 将解药药水更改为治疗药水，其作用类似于治疗药水的轻型版本

source: - Changed Potion of Invisibility into a "tenebrous" spell instead.
target: - 将隐形药水改为“阴暗”法术。

source: - Changed some room templates that were annoying to explore, or created dead-end corridors that looked like they led to a secret door.
target: - 更改了一些令人讨厌的房间模板，或者创建了看起来像通向秘密门的死胡同走廊。

source: - Changed texts in some screens (e.g. "Enter character name" -> "What is your name?")
target: - 更改了某些屏幕中的文本 (例如“输入字符名称” - > “您叫什么名字？”)

source: - Changed the "Kick/bash in what direction?" message to simply "Which direction?", and vice versa for other actions
target: - 将“要朝哪个方向踢击／猛击？”这条消息简化为“哪个方向？”，其他动作的提示也做了相应调整。

source: - Changed the "Opening" spell to "Control Object", which can do more things (e.g. open/close/jam/strike doors, or strike statues/braziers, etc)
target: - 将“开启”法术改名为“控制物体”，并扩展其功能，例如开门、关门、卡住或击打门，以及击打雕像和火盆等。
- 更改了弹出窗口的外观

source: - Changed the appearance of the main menu and character creation screens
target: - 更改了主菜单和角色创建屏幕的外观

source: - Changed the Azathoth's Wrath spell to Azathoth's Gaze, which causes small damage and fainting (instead of acting like a "mass Darkbolt")
target: - 将阿撒托斯之怒法术改为阿撒托斯凝视，造成少量伤害和昏厥 (而不是表现得像一个“质量暗螺栓”)

source: - Changed the general color theme in the game - the "blood red" style has been changed to a teal style (inspired by how certain old black and white movies were tinted, e.g. Nosferatu)
target: - 更改了游戏中的总体颜色主题 - “血红色”风格已更改为青色风格 (灵感来自某些古老的黑白电影是如何着色的，例如Nosferatu)

source: - Changed the general color theme of the game's interface
target: - 更改了游戏界面的总体颜色主题

source: - Changed the message log command to [m] instead of [L]
target: - 将消息日志命令更改为 [m] 而不是 [L]

source: - Changed the names of some weapons
target: - 更改了一些武器的名称

source: - Changed the spell casting system to use a mana-like resource called "Spirit", instead of the previous chance-based system. The reason for this is similar to the reason for removing physical/mental status resistances (mentioned above) - it was too unpredictable and luck dependant. Now it should be easier to make tactical decisions about spell casting.
target: - 施法系统改为消耗类似法力的资源“精神值”，取代之前基于成功几率的系统。原因与移除躯体／精神状态抗性相似（见上文）：旧系统过于难以预测，也太依赖运气。现在施法时应该更容易做出战术决策。

source: - Changed the tile set size to 20x0 (from 24x24), most of the tiles are simply cropped since they had a lot of redundant black space around them, and a few tiles have been slightly reworked.
target: - 将图块集大小更改为 20x0 (从24x24)，大多数图块都被简单地裁剪，因为它们周围有很多多余的黑色空间，并且一些图块已被稍微修改。

source: - Changed the way monsters cause shock. Previously you would take a big hit on the first turn that you see the monster, then smaller hits for each turn. Now the shock taken starts at 0 instead, and increases slowly. This gives more opportunity to retreat, or to take down the monsters swiftly before taking too much shock.
target: - 改变了怪物造成冲击的方式。以前，你会在看到怪物的第一个回合受到很大的打击，然后每回合受到较小的打击。现在所承受的冲击从 0 开始，并缓慢增加。这提供了更多的机会撤退，或者在受到太大冲击之前迅速击倒怪物。

source: - Character info screen (accessed with [@]) gives more info - combat stats, resistances, item knowledge
target: - 角色信息屏幕 (通过[@]访问) 提供更多信息 - 战斗统计数据、阻力、物品知识

source: - Characters have size data. Ranged attacks have rules for what character sizes can be hit - resulting in more intuitive behaviour such as:
target: - 角色有尺寸数据。远程攻击对于可以击中的角色大小有规则 - 从而产生更直观的行为，例如：

source: - Chasms are now drawn with a dark blue checkered rectangle instead of a blue dot (if using tiles).
target: - 裂缝现在用深蓝色方格矩形而不是蓝点 (如果使用瓷砖) 绘制。

source: - Chests are never made of iron until at least dungeon level 3
target: - 地城层数达到第 3 层之前，箱子绝不会由铁制成。

source: - Chests can no longer be trapped (it was awkward to deal with, and didn't really bring anything to the game) - chests are now interacted with merely by bumping them (if they are not locked), kicking them, or using an Opening spell
target: - 箱子不再被困住 (处理起来很尴尬，并没有给比赛带来任何东西) - 箱子现在只需通过碰撞 (如果它们没有被锁定)、踢它们或使用开放咒语即可与之交互

source: - Clairvoyant Occultists also starts with the Premonition spell
target: - 千里眼神秘主义者也从预感咒语开始

source: - Claustrophobia can not happen next to chasms
target: - 幽闭恐惧症不会发生在裂缝旁边

source: - Clear Oozes are somewhat easier to spot
target: - 透明软泥怪更容易被发现

source: - Command for unloading ammo from a gun on the ground ('u').
target: - 从地面上的枪中卸载弹药的命令 ('u')。

source: - command to wait for 10 turns (useful to search for hidden things)
target: -命令等待10轮(对搜索隐藏的东西很有用)

source: - Completely removed "acid" as a damage type and concept from the game. Bloated Corpse and Corpse Mound spit now do zero damage and apply infection instead, Strange Colors do pure damage.
target: - 从游戏中完全删除“酸”作为伤害类型和概念。臃肿的尸体和尸丘吐口水现在造成零伤害并施加感染，奇怪的颜色造成纯粹的伤害。

source: - Completely removed the concept of dice rolls from the game, weapon damage is now specified as a range (e.g. 1-4) instead of dice rolls and sides (e.g. 1d4)
target: - 游戏中已完全移除掷骰子的概念。武器伤害现在以范围表示（例如 1–4），不再用骰子数量和面数表示（例如 1d4）。

source: - Completely reworked and renamed the Spirit Dagger
target: - 彻底重新设计并更名为灵魂匕首

source: - Corpses blow up from explosions (can be used to prevent zombies from rising).
target: - 尸体因爆炸 (可用于阻止僵尸崛起) 而爆炸。
- 尸体／血肉飞溅效果会根据攻击力度变化。

source: - Corrected a misplaced word in a monster description
target: - 修正了怪物描述中的错误单词

source: - Corrected a spelling error in an ability description
target: - 修正了能力描述中的拼写错误

source: - CPU usage % should be much lower
target: - CPU 使用率应该低得多

source: - Crimson Passage also gave a free move when it ended due to hit points being too low (now it only gives a free move if it is possible to "pay" the hit point cost).
target: - 猩红通道由于生命值太低而结束时还提供了自由移动(现在，只有在可以“支付”命中点成本的情况下，它才会给出一个免费的动作)。

source: - Critical misses for melee attacks (1% chance normally) now cause various bad things to happen, such as becoming exhausted, or dropping the weapon
target: - 近战攻击严重失误（通常有 1% 几率）现在会引发各种负面结果，例如精疲力尽或掉落武器。

source: - Critically failing a melee attack can no longer result in dropping the weapon
target: - 近战攻击严重失败不再导致武器掉落

source: - Crypt rooms (tomb rooms) and ritual rooms (rooms with altars) can also spawn in the late game caves.
target: - 地穴房间 (墓室) 和仪式房间 (带祭坛的房间) 也可以在游戏后期的洞穴中生成。

source: - Cultist anger phrases were too infrequent in the previous version
target: - 邪教愤怒短语在之前的版本中太少见

source: - Cultist have a different tile depending on their wielded firearm, and their description states what weapon they are wielding
target: - 邪教徒根据他们所使用的枪支拥有不同的图块，并且他们的描述说明了他们所使用的武器

source: - Cultists can drop scrolls and potions
target: - 邪教徒可以掉落卷轴和药剂

source: - Cultists fire their weapons more often
target: - 邪教徒更频繁地使用武器

source: - Current turn number is now displayed in the gui.
target: - 现在会在 GUI 中显示当前回合数。

source: - Damage per turn from burning is reduced
target: - 每回合燃烧造成的伤害减少

source: - Dark areas now have less permissive field of view for spotting walls, previously it was easy to explore the walls in dark areas, whereas now you need to be adjacent to it - for a more atmospheric and oppressive feeling
target: - 黑暗区域现在对于发现墙壁的视野不太宽松，以前很容易探索黑暗区域的墙壁，而现在你需要靠近它 - 以获得更大气和压抑的感觉

source: - Darkbolt and Azathoth's Wrath do random damage within a range, instead of a fixed number
target: - 暗箭和阿撒托斯之怒在一定范围内造成随机伤害，而不是固定数量

source: - Darkness did not give a stealth bonus
target: - 黑暗没有给予潜行奖励

source: - Darkness gives shock instead of the room (so lighting up a dark area with a flare removes the shock)
target: - 黑暗代替房间给人震撼 (所以用耀斑照亮黑暗区域可以消除电击)

source: - Dart traps, spear traps, and alarm traps now always trigger instantly when a creature steps on them.
target: - 飞镖陷阱、矛陷阱和警报陷阱现在总是在生物踩到它们时立即触发。

source: - Death Fiends now do a more sensible amount of damage (and the part of their description which said their attack "means almost certain death" has been removed)
target: - 死亡恶魔现在造成更合理的伤害 (他们的描述中说他们的攻击“意味着几乎肯定的死亡”的部分已被删除)
- 死亡发生在 0hp 而不是 -1

source: - Decreased the HP of all monsters
- Deep Ones are not delayed when moving through liquids
target: - 深潜者在液体中移动时不会延迟

source: - Deep Ones can throw a net which entangles the victim (instead of throwing a spear)
target: - 深潜者可以抛出一张网来缠住受害者 (而不是扔长矛)

source: - Deep Ones usually spawn in much smaller numbers than before
target: - 深潜者的生成数量通常比以前少得多

source: - Default aim position is at last monster attacked
target: - 默认目标位置是最后一个怪物受到攻击的位置
- 不同的急救 (非基于项目)

source: - Different monsters have different spell skill levels - spells cast by more powerful monsters will typically hurt more, last longer, summon nastier monsters, etc
target: - 不同的怪物有不同的法术技能等级 - 更强大的怪物施放的法术通常会伤害更多，持续时间更长，召唤更可怕的怪物等

source: - Disarming traps gives a small amount of XP
- Disease last much longer (but there are two types of potions that removes disease)
target: - 疾病持续时间更长 (但有两种类型的药水可以消除疾病)

source: - Disease lowers you to 3/4 HP instead of 1/2 HP
target: - 疾病会将你的生命值降至原来的 3/4，而不是 1/2。

source: - Disease temporarily lowers your maximum HP, instead of making you rapidly lose HP down to a certain limit (with the old method it was always possible to heal yourself, even though it was useless)
target: - 疾病现在会暂时降低你的生命值上限，而不是迅速扣除生命值直至某个阈值（旧机制下即使治疗毫无用处，你仍然可以继续治疗）。

source: - Dispelling magic traps grants spirit points
target: - 消除魔法陷阱可获得精神点

source: - Dodging also applies to ranged attacks
target: - 躲避也适用于远程攻击

source: - Doors can be jammed with iron spikes (j)
- Doors no longer have a "broken" state - instead, breaking them simply converts them to "rubble"
target: - 门不再具有“破碎”状态 - 相反，打破它们只会将它们转换为“碎石”

source: - Double clicking anywhere toggles fullscreen. Also added an option to enable/disable this feature.
target: - 在任意位置双击都可切换全屏；此外还新增了启用或禁用此功能的选项。

source: - Dropping items is now done from a separate inventory screen, accessed by pressing "d" (which is a more conventional method than the old way of pressing shift+enter)
target: - 现在通过单独的物品栏界面丢弃物品，按“d”进入（这比旧版按 Shift+Enter 的方式更常见）。

source: - Due to the above change, the Flagellant trait "Fervor" has been renamed to "Enthusiasm".
target: - 由于上述变化，鞭打者特质“热情”已更名为“热情”。

source: - Dynamite explodes in your hands if you hold it too long.
target: - 如果你握得太久，炸药就会在你手中爆炸。

source: - Each melee trait gives +5% chance to evade melee attacks
target: - 每个近战特性都有+5%的几率躲避近战攻击

source: - Each section of the manual is shown on a separate screen, accessed from a menu
target: - 手册的每个部分都显示在单独的屏幕上，可通过菜单访问

source: - Energy Vortex attacks has a paralyzing effect as they were supposed to have, instead of burning
target: - 能量漩涡攻击具有麻痹效果，因为它们应该具有，而不是燃烧

source: - Energy Vortexes were not resistant to electricity
- Entry for sneaking and backstabbing in the manual
target: - 手册中关于潜行和背后刺伤的条目

source: - Equippable items (armor, weapons, head-wear) can now be equipped by selecting them directly in the backpack, automatically swapping out any existing item in the target equipment slot (which of course takes more turns to perform)
target: - 现在可以直接在背包中选择可装备物品（护甲、武器、头部装备）来穿戴，并自动替换对应装备栏中的物品（当然，这样做需要更多回合）。

source: - Esc and space also works as "no" for all y/n prompts
target: - 在所有是／否提示中，按退出键或空格键也会被视为“否”。

source: - Esc works as alternative quit command (same as [Q])
target: - 按退出键也可作为替代退出命令（与 [Q] 相同）。

source: - Every melee attack was presented like a back-stab (only the message was bugged though)
target: - 所有近战攻击看起来都像背刺（实际上出错的只有提示消息）。

source: - Exorcists can no longer store spirit points above max level indefinitely, instead they gain fervor points for destroying manuscripts, altars, etc. Fervor can be used for casting spells, and is used automatically when there is not enough spirit points to cast from. The "Prolonged Life" trait also uses fervor instead of spirit.
target: - 驱魔师不再可以无限期地存储高于最高等级的精神点，而是通过摧毁手稿、祭坛等获得热情点。热情可以用于施法，当没有足够的精神点可以施法时会自动使用。 “长寿”特质也用的是热情而不是精神。

source: - Exorcists picking a stack of Manuscripts destroyed the whole stack, but only gave bonuses for one Manuscript.
target: - 拾取一堆手稿的驱魔师摧毁了整堆手稿，但只为一份手稿提供奖励。

source: - Expanded the command list screen to a brief manual
target: - 将命令列表屏幕扩展为简短的手册

source: - Explosions destroy walls and doors (destroyed walls may leave rocks)
target: - 爆炸会摧毁墙壁和门（被摧毁的墙壁可能留下石块）。

source: - Fewer monsters are spawned on the map overall, and many monster types now tend to spawn in smaller groups, but are individually stronger - they also generally follow and remember you for a shorter time than before
target: - 总体而言，地图上生成的怪物较少，许多怪物类型现在倾向于以较小的群体生成，但个体更强大 - 它们通常跟随并记住你的时间也比以前更短

source: - Fire Hound bites now also causes Burning (like their ranged attacks)
target: - 火焰猎犬的撕咬现在也会造成燃烧（与它们的远程攻击相同）。

source: - Firearms and thrown weapons have limited effective ranges, beyond which their damage is halved. When selecting target, the marker is colored orange beyond the effective range.
target: - 枪械和投掷武器的有效射程有限，超出范围后伤害减半。选择目标时，超出有效范围的标记将显示为橙色。

source: - Firearms have effective range limits (half damage beyond it), the line drawn while aiming is green inside the limit and yellow beyond it
target: - 枪械现在有有效射程限制（超出射程时伤害减半）。瞄准时，射程内的瞄准线为绿色，超出射程则为黄色。

source: - Firearms on the ground have white symbol if they have ammo loaded, otherwise gray.
target: - 地面上的枪支如果装有弹药，则有白色符号，否则呈灰色。

source: - First aid can not be started if a monster is seen, and is automatically aborted if one appears
target: - 如果看到怪物则无法开始急救，如果出现则自动中止

source: - Fixed a bug that (in some rare specific cases) allowed monsters to move into the position already occupied by another monster
target: - 修复了一个错误：在少数特定情况下，怪物可能移动到已被另一只怪物占据的位置。

source: - Fixed a bug that allowed explosion graphics to be rendered in unseen cells
target: - 修复了允许在看不见的单元中渲染爆炸图形的错误

source: - Fixed a bug that allowed saving anywhere
target: - 修复了允许在任何地方保存的错误

source: - Fixed a bug that caused enemies to spawn inside your field of view
target: - 修复了导致敌人在您的视野内生成的错误

source: - Fixed a bug that caused Expert Marksman go give a double upgrade, and Master Marksman to give no upgrade at all (this bug has existed since v20.0).
target: - 修复了神射手专家会获得双重升级、神射手大师却完全无法升级的问题（该错误自 v20.0 起就存在）。

source: - Fixed a bug that caused interruptions of longer player actions (handling armor or using the medical bag). The problem was that status effects that interrupt the player (fainting, burning, entangled, stuck, etc) would interrupt regardless of which creature it was applied to. The effect of this was probably most often noticeable when monsters outside view got stuck in mud.
target: - 修复了较长玩家操作（穿戴护甲或使用医疗包）会被中断的问题。此前，昏厥、燃烧、缠绕、受困等打断玩家的状态效果，无论施加给哪个生物都会中断玩家操作；当视野外的怪物陷入泥中时，这个问题尤其明显。

source: - Fixed a bug that caused monsters with Fear Resistance to end all player phobias when they spawned (this was mistakenly reported to the insanity system as a "player gaining permanent rFear" event)
target: - 修复了具有恐惧抗性的怪物生成时会结束玩家所有恐惧症的问题（此前系统误将此情况记录为“玩家永久获得恐惧抗性”事件）。

source: - Fixed a bug that caused properties to "stick" on an item if it was dropped while wearing it (if the item was picked up again, the properties were enabled on the player even when the item was just carried in the backpack)
target: - 修复了穿戴物品时将其丢下会导致属性“粘”在物品上的错误（重新拾取后，即使只把物品放在背包里，这些属性也会作用于玩家）。

source: - Fixed a bug that caused the 'get' command to crash the game after loading a save file
target: - 修复了加载保存文件后导致“get”命令崩溃游戏的错误

source: - Fixed a bug that caused the player's dodge chance to be calculated the wrong way when Ghosts attempted to "touch" you
target: - 修复了当幽灵试图“触摸”你时导致玩家的闪避几率计算错误的错误

source: - Fixed a bug that caused unique monsters to sometimes spawn more than once
target: - 修复了导致独特怪物有时多次生成的错误

source: - Fixed a bug that could crash the game, especially during map generation (thanks "stevebob"!)
target: - 修复了一个可能导致游戏崩溃的错误，尤其是地图生成期间。（感谢 “stevebob”！）

source: - Fixed a bug that prevented backstabs from giving hit chance bonus in many cases
target: - 修复了在许多情况下阻止背刺给予命中机会奖励的错误

source: - Fixed a bug that prevented Flare Guns from burning the target
target: - 修复了信号枪无法燃烧目标的错误

source: - Fixed a bug that prevented hit chance bonus against unaware targets for ranged attacks
target: - 修正了一个错误，该错误导致对不知情的目标进行远程攻击时无法获得命中率奖励

source: - Fixed a bug that prevented hit chance bonus vs unaware monsters
target: - 修正了一个错误，该错误阻止了对不知情的怪物的命中机会奖励

source: - Fixed a bug that prevented messages for Rogues sensing artifacts on the dungeon floor (there were only messages for sensing artifacts in item containers, such as tombs)
target: - 修复了盗贼无法获得在地城地面感知遗物的提示的问题（此前只有感知物品容器中的遗物时才会显示提示，例如墓穴中的遗物）。

source: - Fixed a bug that prevented monsters from stepping on corpses

source: - Fixed a bug that prevented Ooze-type monsters from passing through closed doors (they should be able to do this)
target: - 修复了软泥类怪物无法穿过关闭的门的错误（它们本来就应该能穿过）。

source: - Fixed a bug that prevented using Page Up/Page Down/Home/End for diagonal movement
target: - 修复了无法使用上翻页／下翻页／主页／末页键进行斜向移动的错误。

source: - Fixed a bug that prevented you from using melee attacks on a turn that you had a free move from the "Dextrous" bonus, and walked in liquid
target: - 修复了一个错误，该错误会阻止您在拥有“灵巧”奖励的自由移动并在液体中行走的回合中使用近战攻击

source: - Fixed a bug were teleporting or being knocked back while held by a spider web, caused the web to be able to hold any creature that walked into it, regardless of monster type (e.g. ethereal monsters or spiders could then also be held)
target: - 修复了一个错误：生物被蛛网困住时传送或被击退后，蛛网会错误地困住任何走入其中的生物，而不再检查怪物类型（例如，以太怪物或蜘蛛也会被困住）。

source: - Fixed a bug where bumping a hidden door would print a different message than bumping a wall (and thus indicating the presence of the door)
target: - 修复了撞击隐藏门时显示的消息与撞击墙壁不同的错误（这会暴露门的位置）。

source: - Fixed a bug where carrying multiple electric lanterns prevented you from using any other than the top one
target: - 修复了携带多个电灯笼导致您无法使用除顶部电灯笼之外的任何灯笼的错误

source: - Fixed a bug where creatures (e.g. the player) could get knocked into impassable terrain (such as walls), if they had physical damage resistance.
target: - 修复了具有物理伤害抗性的生物可能被击入不可通行地形（例如墙壁）的问题。

source: - Fixed a bug where dropping the Staff of the Pharaohs would cause the spell to be permanently lost, even if the staff was picked up again
target: - 修复了掉落法老王之杖会导致法术永久丢失的错误，即使再次拾取法老之杖也会导致法术永久丢失

source: - Fixed a bug where the player killing themselves with an Incinerator would freeze the game.
target: - 修正了玩家用焚化炉自杀会冻结游戏的错误。

source: - Fixed a bug which prevented accessing the manual ("Tome of Wisdom") from the esc-menu during a game
target: - 修复了游戏过程中无法从 Esc 菜单打开手册（“智慧之书”）的问题。

source: - Fixed a bug which removed the Sentry Drone monster from the game - preventing both usage of the Sentry Drone device, and hostile Sentry Drones from spawning on the map
target: - 修复了从游戏中移除哨兵无人机怪物的错误 - 阻止哨兵无人机设备的使用以及敌对哨兵无人机在地图上生成

source: - Fixed a bug with machine gun weapons (killing a monster caused the following bullets to hit the floor where he stood. Now machine guns are more effective against rows of monsters)
target: - 修复了机枪类武器的一个错误：击杀怪物后，后续子弹会射向它原来站立位置的地面。现在机枪对付成排的怪物更加有效。

source: - Fixed a crash bug for the Incinerator weapon (the game could crash when the projectile reached its max range)
target: - 修复了焚化炉武器的崩溃问题（弹体飞到最大射程时可能导致游戏崩溃）。

source: - Fixed a crash that occurred if enter was pressed while equipping a slot with no available items
target: - 修复了尝试装备没有可用物品的槽位时按回车键导致游戏崩溃的问题。

source: - Fixed a crash that occurred if shift + enter (drop item) was pressed while a slot with no item was selected
target: - 修复了选中空槽位时按 Shift + 回车键（丢弃物品）导致游戏崩溃的问题。

source: - Fixed a faulty message when pressing "t" with no item selected for throwing (the message adviced to press "w" to wield a throwing weapon, but the actual key should be "i")
target: - 修复了未选择投掷物品时按“t”显示错误提示的问题（提示要求按“w”装备投掷武器，但正确按键应为“i”）。

source: - Fixed a faulty message when throwing potions on monsters ("it had no apparent effect..." even when the effect was obvious. Only the message was wrong though, not the actual identification)
target: - 修复了向怪物投掷药水时的一条错误消息：即使效果很明显，消息仍会显示“似乎没有效果……”。只有提示文字有误，实际鉴定结果不受影响。

source: - Fixed a graphical bug with gas traps
target: - 修复了气体陷阱的图形错误

source: - Fixed a graphical bug with smoke
target: - 修复了烟雾的图形错误

source: - Fixed a graphical glitch with Tommy Gun and Tesla Cannon.
target: - 修复了汤米枪和特斯拉大炮的图形故障。

source: - Fixed a horrible horrible bug that prevented the player from dodging melee attacks
target: - 修复了一个可怕的错误，该错误使玩家无法躲避近战攻击

source: - Fixed a minor problem with the field of view (too many wall cells were revealed in some circumstances)
target: - 修复了视野系统的一个小问题：某些情况下会揭示过多墙壁格子。

source: - Fixed a problem with save files messing up identified potions
target: - 修复了保存文件弄乱已识别药水的问题

source: - Fixed a problem with the game time system, that caused slow creatures to act slightly more often and fast/very fast creatures to act slightly less often than they were supposed to (especially noticeable when kiting a slow monster, since it would occasionally get unexpected extra moves).
target: - 修复了游戏时间系统的问题：慢速生物行动次数略多于预期，而快速或极快速生物的行动次数略少于预期；追逐慢速怪物时尤其明显，因为它偶尔会意外多行动几次。

source: - Fixed a timing issue when the player controls teleportation (e.g. when casting teleport, game time would pass between casting the spell and getting to control the teleport location). Now the control happens instantly.
target: - 修复了玩家控制传送时的计时问题（例如，施放传送法术后，到玩家开始选择传送位置之间，游戏时间原本仍会流逝）。现在可以立即控制传送位置。

source: - Fixed a typo that said "Press 'v'" when you tried to throw a missile with empty missile slot. Changed it to say "Press 'w'", which is the actual command to equip items.
target: - 修复了当你试图投掷空导弹槽的导弹时显示“按‘v’”的拼写错误。将其更改为“按'w'”，这是装备物品的实际命令。

source: - Fixed a typo when reading scrolls
target: - 修复了阅读卷轴时的拼写错误

source: - Fixed an issue where activating a "Blaster" Strange Device would tick game time twice.
target: - 修复了激活“爆破者”奇异装置会使游戏时间推进两次的问题。

source: - Fixed Fire Hound projectile animation in tiles mode (a small "blast" tile instead of a bunch of forward slashes)
target: - 修复了图块模式下的火焰猎犬弹体动画（现在显示一个小型“爆炸”图块，而非一串斜线）。

source: - Fixed many bugs related to properties (especially concerning properties which were supposed to be permanent, but would time out - e.g. confusion resistance gained from picking the trait "Self-aware")
target: - 修复了许多与属性有关的错误，尤其是本应永久生效却会超时的属性（例如选择“自我觉察”特质获得的困惑抗性）。

source: - Fixed many bugs related to saving/loading (e.g. crashing, losing memorized spells)
target: - 修复了许多与保存／载入有关的错误（例如游戏崩溃、已记忆的法术丢失）。

source: - Fixed problem with popups not being re-drawn correctly when alt-tabbing back to the game
target: - 修复了从其他窗口切回游戏后，弹窗没有正确重绘的问题。

source: - Fixed some buggy item drop code (which may have caused crashes)
target: - 修复了一些有问题的物品掉落代码，这些问题可能导致游戏崩溃。

source: - Fixed some bugs in the monster movement AI (it wasn't anything critical, but it made them act a bit weird in a few specific situations)
target: - 修复了怪物移动 AI 中的一些问题（并非严重问题，但在少数特定情况下会让怪物行动得有些奇怪）。

source: - Fixed some cases where redundant sound messages were printed when handling doors ("I hear a door open. I see a door opening.")
target: - 修复了处理门时重复显示声音消息的情况（“我听见门打开了。”“我看见一扇门正在打开。”）。

source: - Fixed some code that may have made the game less stable
target: - 修复了一些可能导致游戏不稳定的代码

source: - Fixed some errors in Manuscript names (underscores had snuck into a few names for some reason)
target: - 修正了部分手稿名称中的错误（不知为何，有些名称里混入了下划线）。

source: - Fixed some minor bugs in the map generator (the map generator can also do a few new things now, although it's probably subtle)
target: - 修复了地图生成器中的一些小问题（地图生成器现在也新增了一些功能，不过变化可能不太明显）。

source: - Fixed some problems with keyboard input and the game directory
target: - 修复了键盘输入和游戏目录的一些问题

source: - Fixed: "High ceiling rooms" could spawn monsters outside the room
target: - 修正：“高天花板房间”可能会在房间外产生怪物

source: - Fixed: Armor durability and clip ammo count were not stored in save files
target: - 修正：装甲耐久度和弹药夹数量未存储在保存文件中

source: - Fixed: Explosions crashed the game in certain situations
target: - 修正：爆炸在某些情况下导致游戏崩溃

source: - Fixed: Status effect countdown did not occur on some turns
target: - 修正：某些回合没有发生状态效果倒计时

source: - Fixed: The player color updates immediately after healing (instead of the turn after)
target: - 修复：治疗后玩家的颜色现在会立即更新（而不是等到下一个回合）。

source: - Fixed: There was a situation that put the game in an infinite loop (not responding)
target: - 修复：某些情况下游戏会陷入无限循环并停止响应。

source: - Flagellants also start with a potion of vitality.
target: - 鞭打者也从一瓶活力药水开始。

source: - Flares light up a circular area of darkness (the flare's field of view), instead of lighting up the whole room
target: - 信号棒现在会照亮一片圆形区域（信号棒的视野范围），而不是照亮整个房间。

source: - Floor cells lit by an Electric lantern, flare, burning creature, etc are now marked with yellow color
target: - 由电灯、照明弹、燃烧生物等照亮的地板单元现在标记为黄色

source: - Flying creatures actually fly (can fly over chasms, acid, etc)
target: - 飞行生物现在会真正飞行（可飞越裂隙、酸液等）。

source: - Flying monsters can no longer be killed by kicking them into chasms
target: - 飞行怪物不再可以通过将它们踢入裂缝来杀死

source: - For Exorcist spell traits, available spirit info is no longer printed in the character info screen, only when picking a trait (also the character info screen could show wrong numbers).
target: - 驱魔师选择法术特质时才会显示可用精神值；角色信息界面不再显示这项信息（此前该界面显示的数值也可能有误）。
