target: - 现在喝下降药水时会有延迟，直到效果发生

source: - There is now a log of "historic events" (such as identifying a potion, or killing a unique monster) viewable from the character info screen or from the game info screen after the game is over
target: - 现在可以从角色信息屏幕或游戏结束后的游戏信息屏幕中查看“历史事件”日志（例如识别药水或杀死独特的怪物）

source: - There is now much smaller chance of gaining multiple phobias, and you can never become both sadistic and masochistic at the same time
target: - 获得多种恐惧症的几率大幅降低；施虐癖和受虐癖也不可能同时出现。

source: - There is now two lines for displaying messages - significantly reducing the number of "--More--" prompts.
target: - 现在有两行用于显示消息 - 显着减少了“--更多--”提示的数量。

source: - There was some problems with the map in the postmortem screen
target: - 事后分析屏幕中的地图存在一些问题

source: - Three new level-up bonuses to choose from
target: - 三种新的升级奖励可供选择

source: - Throwing explosives in tiles mode now draws the items tile instead of its ASCII character
target: - 在平铺模式下投掷炸药现在会绘制物品平铺而不是 ASCII 字符

source: - Throwing knives do 2d3 damage (avg 4.0) instead of 1d6 (avg 3.5), and have +10% hit chance
target: - 飞刀造成 2d3 伤害（平均 4.0），而不是 1d6（平均 3.5），并且命中率 +10%

source: - Thrown items makes sounds when hitting hard surfaces
target: - 投掷的物品撞击坚硬的表面时会发出声音

source: - Thrown objects may now pass through ethereal monsters (in the previous version, this rule mistakenly only applied to firearms and melee attacks)
target: - 投掷物体现在可以穿过空灵怪物（在之前的版本中，此规则错误地仅适用于枪械和近战攻击）

source: - To make it easier to notice when shocking events happen, exclamation marks ("!") are now drawn on the player character if enough shock is received during a turn (up to three marks can be drawn)
target: - 为了更容易注意到令人震慑的事件，若你在一回合内承受了足够的震慑，角色身上会显示感叹号（“！”）（最多可显示三个）

source: - Toughness increases HP instead of decreasing damage taken
target: - 韧性会增加生命值而不是减少受到的伤害

source: - Traps are always destroyed after they are triggered (i.e. they can only ever be triggered once).
target: - 陷阱在触发后总是会被摧毁（即它们只能被触发一次）。

source: - Traps are always immediately revealed when triggered by the player
target: - 当玩家触发时，陷阱总是会立即显露出来

source: - Traps are always triggered when bumped, and always removed when disarmed
target: - 陷阱总是在碰撞时触发，并且总是在解除武装时移除

source: - Treasure Hunter increases items spawned on each floor by 1, instead of 1-2. See also general change to number of items spawned below.
target: - 宝藏猎人将每层生成的物品增加 1 个，而不是 1-2 个。另请参阅下面生成的物品数量的一般变化。

source: - Trees appearing beneath the first few levels are now "giant fungi" instead
target: - 出现在前几层下方的树木现在变成了“巨型真菌”

source: - Turn number is now stored in the save file
target: - 回合数现在存储在保存文件中

source: - Unaware monsters have blue backgrounds instead of a blue underscore
target: - 不知道的怪物有蓝色背景而不是蓝色下划线

source: - Unequipping any item spends a turn
target: - 卸下任何物品需要花费一个回合

source: - Unidentified Rods do not display their recharge countdown - attempting to use an unidentified Rod before it's recharged wastes a turn (with the same message as if the effect is unknown), but does not reset the countdown
target: - 未鉴定的魔棒不会显示充能倒计时——若在充能完成前尝试使用未鉴定的魔棒，会浪费一个回合（显示与效果未知时相同的信息），但不会重置倒计时

source: - Unload command also works for picking up ammo (convenient when you want to get all the ammo dropped from a monster, but not the gun)
target: - 卸载命令也适用于拾取弹药（当您想要获得从怪物身上掉落的所有弹药，但不是枪时，很方便）

source: - Unseen cells are darker than in previous versions, and very slightly coloured blue
target: - 看不见的单元格比以前的版本更暗，并且颜色非常淡蓝色

source: - Updated the score formula to include turn count (lower turn counts give higher scores), also a winning game now guarantees higher score than a non-winning game
target: - 更新了得分公式以包括回合数（回合数越低得分越高），获胜游戏现在也保证比非获胜游戏得分更高

source: - Updated trap placement - magic traps cannot be placed in blocking positions (since only Occultists can disarm them), traps tend to be more spread out in a room instead of clustered together, traps can be placed in corridors, and generally fewer traps are placed on the map overall
target: - 更新的陷阱放置 - 魔法陷阱不能放置在阻挡位置（因为只有神秘主义者可以解除它们的武装），陷阱往往更分散在房间中而不是聚集在一起，陷阱可以放置在走廊中，并且通常在整个地图上放置的陷阱较少

source: - User data (such as save file and highscore list) is no longer stored in the game directory, instead the user data location is based on SDL_GetPrefPath() and the current version/checksum of the game (e.g. "~/.local/share/infra_arcana/873f2d0e/") - the Infra Arcana game directory is now treated as read-only.
target: - 用户数据（如存档和高分列表）不再保存在游戏目录中，而会根据 SDL_GetPrefPath() 以及游戏当前版本和校验和存放（例如 "~/.local/share/infra_arcana/873f2d0e/"）。Infra Arcana 游戏目录现在按只读方式处理。

source: - Using coloring more for the player stats to convey information (such as drawing the current hit points paler the closer to zero they are, or drawing the weapon info as yellow if ammo is depleted)
target: - 对玩家统计数据使用更多颜色来传达信息（例如，当前生命值越接近于零，则将其绘制得越浅，或者如果弹药耗尽，则将武器信息绘制为黄色）

source: - Using Rods causes less shock than before
target: - 使用魔棒造成的震慑比以前更低

source: - Using SDL for rendering/input again (it seems more compatible with a wider range of systems)
target: - 重新使用 SDL 进行画面渲染和输入处理（它似乎兼容更多系统）。

source: - Using the 'fire' command while aiming at yourself cancels the aiming mode
target: - 瞄准自己时使用“开火”命令会取消瞄准模式
- 调整了平衡性并修复了一些行为问题。

source: - Various weapon rebalancing, especially to make medium/heavy weapons more relevant compared to daggers.
target: - 调整多种武器的平衡，尤其是让中型和重型武器相较匕首更有用。

source: - Varying damage (pluses) on spawned melee weapons
target: - 对生成的近战武器造成不同的伤害（加值）

source: - Video scaling is now also possible in windowed mode.
target: - 现在在窗口模式下也可以进行视频缩放。

source: - Viewing information about known spells while picking a new trait was handled poorly if the player did not know any spells.
target: - 玩家不知道任何法术时，选择新特质期间查看已知法术信息会出现异常

source: - Void Travelers intercepting player teleportation now also ends invisibility and cloaking.
target: - 虚空旅行者拦截玩家传送现在也结束了隐形和隐形。

source: - Vortex monsters no longer "explode" when they die
target: - 漩涡怪物死亡时不再“爆炸”
- 在液体中行走可以停止燃烧

source: - Walls now draw the front wall tile instead of the top tile if the cell below is unexplored
target: - 如果下面的单元格未被探索，墙壁现在会绘制前墙瓷砖而不是顶部瓷砖

source: - Weakening now causes halved melee damage, instead of minimum melee damage
target: - 削弱现在导致近战伤害减半，而不是最小近战伤害

source: - Weapon names show average damage instead of dice rolls - melee weapons also show their "plus" damage bonus (not including any damage bonus from traits), e.g. "Machete 9.0 {+2} +0%" - the exact dice rolls can be seen in the detailed item description when viewing the item in the inventory
target: - 武器名称现在显示平均伤害而非骰子结果；近战武器还会显示“加值”伤害奖励（不包括特质提供的伤害奖励），例如“Machete 9.0 {+2} +0%”。查看物品栏中的详细说明仍可查看确切的骰子结果。

source: - Weapons no longer have a chance to break when the player does a melee attack while cursed.
target: - 当玩家在受到诅咒的情况下进行近战攻击时，武器不再有机会损坏。

source: - Weapons now merely display their own hit chance modifier (e.g. +5% or -10%), instead of your skill plus the weapon modifier (the old way was misleading, since more factors are involved when calculating actual hit chances during attacks)
target: - 武器现在只显示自身的命中率修正值（例如 +5% 或 -10%），不再显示角色技能与武器修正值之和（旧显示方式容易误导，因为攻击时计算实际命中率还会考虑更多因素）。

source: - When [l]ooking at a weapon on the ground, damage, hit chance and loaded ammo is displayed
target: - 当[l]查看地面上的武器时，会显示伤害、命中率和已装弹药

source: - When [v]iewing detailed monster descriptions, the game prints hit chances for melee, ranged, and throwing attacks for the player and the monster - with the calculations of the total hit chances shown
target: - 按 [v] 查看怪物详细说明时，游戏会显示玩家和怪物的近战、远程及投掷攻击命中率，并列出总命中率的计算过程。

source: - When [v]iewing the map, the game also prints messages for cells with detected unseen monsters ("There is a creature here")
target: - 按 [v] 查看地图时，如果某些地图格检测到了不可见怪物，游戏也会显示提示（“这里有一个生物”）。

source: - When a creature opens a door, the door cannot be closed until this creature's next turn starts (i.e. you cannot shut a door in the face of a monster who just opened it)
target: - 当一个生物打开一扇门时，在该生物的下一个回合开始之前，门不能关闭（即，你不能在刚刚打开门的怪物面前关上门）

source: - When a magic trap triggers there is now a sound, and a flash of light on the map.
target: - 当魔法陷阱触发时，现在会发出声音，并且地图上会出现闪光。

source: - When aiming explosives, the explosion size is marked on the map
target: - 瞄准炸药时，爆炸尺寸会在地图上标记

source: - When attacking ethereal monsters (e.g. Ghosts-type monsters), the attack will often fail to hit ("My attack passes right through the Ghost!"). In case of ranged attacks, the projectile will often pass through the monster and continue on its path, even if aiming succeeded.
target: - 攻击虚灵怪物（例如幽灵类怪物）时，经常会出现攻击失败的情况（“我的攻击直接穿过了幽灵！”）。在远程攻击的情况下，即使瞄准成功，射弹通常也会穿过怪物并继续其路径。

source: - When attacking invisible monsters who are immune to the attack, a message is printed to indicate this (previously it was only printed for seen monsters)
target: - 当攻击免疫攻击的隐形怪物时，会打印一条消息来表明这一点（以前只为可见的怪物打印）

source: - When bashing or eating multiple corpses in the same cell, Zombie-type monsters are now prioritized (since you want to destroy them as soon as possible before they rise)
target: - 在同一格攻击或吃掉多具尸体时，僵尸类怪物会优先处理（因为应尽可能在它们复活前消灭）。

source: - When browsing high scores, selecting an entry shows the game summary for that entry
target: - 浏览高分时，选择一个条目会显示该条目的游戏摘要

source: - When carry weight is high enough that becoming weakened would cause the weight to go over 100% (i.e. at 85%) the current carry weight percentage is drawn with (tinted) yellow color, orange at 100% or above (staggering), and red at 125% and above (immobile).
target: - 当携带重量很高，以致陷入虚弱后负重会超过 100%（也就是当前负重达到 85%）时，当前负重百分比会以黄色（带色调）显示；达到 100% 或以上（步履蹒跚）时显示为橙色，达到 125% 或以上（无法移动）时显示为红色。

source: - When carrying a Potion, the player eventually gets a "feeling" for if the Potion is benign or malign
target: - 当携带药水时，玩家最终会“感觉”药水是良性的还是恶性的

source: - When carrying Manuscripts, the player eventually gets a "feeling" for which spell domain it belongs to (similarly to Potions)
target: - 携带手稿时，玩家最终会“感觉”到它属于哪个法术领域（类似于魔药）

source: - When cast intrinsically (i.e. not from Manuscripts), some spells can be cast without making noise (this is specified in the spell descriptions)
target: - 当内在施放时（即不是来自手稿），某些法术可以在不发出噪音的情况下施放（这在法术描述中指定）

source: - When encumbered there is now an interval between 100-125% where you are able to move at half speed - at 125% and above you are completely immobile
target: - 当受到阻碍时，现在有一个介于 100-125% 之间的区间，您可以以半速移动 - 在 125% 及以上时，您完全无法移动

source: - When entering player name, the previously used name is filled in as a default name
target: - 输入玩家姓名时，将填写之前使用过的姓名作为默认姓名

source: - When entering text or numbers, the underscore cursor is blinking
target: - 输入文字或数字时，下划线光标闪烁

source: - When Ghosts attack, it says they are "reaching" for the player instead of "clawing" - the old "reach" effect which they did in addition to their normal attack has been removed
target: - 当幽灵攻击时，它会说他们正在“触及”玩家而不是“抓握” - 除了正常攻击之外，他们所做的旧“触及”效果已被删除

source: - When holding lit dynamite, the messages tells how many turns are left on the fuse
target: - 持有已点燃的炸药时，信息会显示引信还剩多少回合

source: - When kicking statues while blind, the sound message would never be printed ("I hear a crash.").
target: - 当盲人踢雕像时，永远不会打印声音信息（“我听到撞击声。”）。

source: - When looking at melee weapons on the floor, their +damage is seen (if they have it)
target: - 当查看地板上的近战武器时，可以看到它们的+伤害（如果有的话）

source: - When Major Clapham-Lee "calls forth his Tomb-Legions", the summoned monsters now wait a turn instead of acting immediately.
target: - 当克拉彭·李少校“召唤他的古墓军团”时，召唤的怪物现在会等待一个回合，而不是立即行动。

source: - When Mi-go commanders dropped their armor on death, this was treated as if the player tried to unequip the armor
target: - 当 Mi-go 指挥官在死亡时掉落盔甲时，这被视为玩家试图卸下盔甲

source: - When monsters detect the player due to sounds, they pause for one turn (just like they already did when detecting by vision)
target: - 当怪物通过声音检测到玩家时，它们会暂停一回合（就像通过视觉检测时一样）

source: - When monsters opened a door, the opened door was always updated in the player memory even if they did not see the door being opened.
target: - 当怪物打开门时，打开的门总是会在玩家记忆中更新，即使他们没有看到门被打开。

source: - When not wearing armor, the armor icon is drawn slightly darker than before
target: - 不穿盔甲时，盔甲图标会比以前稍微暗一些

source: - When picking a trait, instead of showing all available and blocked traits in the same list, the trait selection screen now has two modes (toggled with [TAB]) - the first mode shows available traits, and the second shows traits for which the prerequisites are not yet fulfilled
target: - 选择特质时，特质界面现在分为两种模式（按 [TAB] 切换），不再在同一列表中显示可选和受阻特质。第一种模式显示可选特质，第二种显示尚未满足前置条件的特质。

source: - When picking traits, the game now shows all traits and their prerequisites (no information is hidden)
target: - 选择特质时，游戏现在会显示所有特质及其先决条件（不隐藏信息）

source: - When picking up Electric Lanterns or Medical Bags, those items are now combined with existing Lanterns/Medical Bags instead of adding a separate item in the inventory
target: - 拾取电灯笼或医疗包时，会与背包中已有的同类物品合并，而不再作为单独物品加入。

source: - When playing in text mode, the old ascii art graveyard is shown in the postmortem menu screen again
target: - 文本模式下，游戏结束后的菜单中再次显示旧版 ASCII 艺术墓园。

source: - When quaffing Potion of Insight, you can manually choose which item to identify
target: - 饮用洞察药水时，您可以手动选择要识别的物品

source: - When reading a scroll of summoning, the scroll identity is always revealed
target: - 读取召唤卷轴时，卷轴身份始终会被暴露

source: - When reloading, the amount of ammo loaded in the weapon is now printed in the log
target: - 重新装填时，武器中装载的弹药量现在会打印在日志中

source: - When selecting "New Journey" from the main menu, and a saved game exists, the game asks if you really want to start a new game
target: - 当从主菜单中选择“新旅程”并且存在已保存的游戏时，游戏会询问您是否确实要开始新游戏

source: - When standing in a dark position, "DARK AREA" is displayed in the status lines
target: - 玩家站在黑暗区域时，状态栏会显示“黑暗区域”。

source: - When the electric lantern is flickering, it now merely reduces the lit area to 3x3 cells, it can still also malfunction and fail to give any light, or break completely
target: - 当电灯闪烁时，它现在只会将发光区域减少到 3x3 格，但它仍然可能发生故障，无法发出任何光，或者完全损坏

source: - When the game asks for a number (e.g. number of items to drop) this is now done in a popup screen instead.
target: - 当游戏要求输入数字（例如要掉落的物品数量）时，现在会在弹出屏幕中完成。

source: - When the monsters on the "end level" (no spoilers) becomes aware of the player, a message is printed (to reduce the need for meta knowledge).
target: - 当“最终关卡”（无剧透）的怪物意识到玩家时，会打印一条消息（以减少对元知识的需求）。

source: - When the player is kicking a position with a monster they are aware of inside blocking terrain (e.g. a rat inside rubble, or a ghost on a closed door), the monster is now prioritized for kicking instead of the terrain (but if they are unaware of the monster, the terrain will be kicked instead).
target: - 当玩家用怪物踢某个位置时，他们知道有阻挡地形（例如，瓦砾中的老鼠，或关闭的门上的鬼魂），现在优先踢怪物而不是地形（但如果他们不知道怪物，则地形将被踢）。

source: - When using the Medical Bag, a menu is now shown where you can select the treatment to perform. Also added an option to automatically choose treatment like before.
target: - 使用医疗包时，现在会显示一个菜单，您可以在其中选择要执行的治疗。还添加了一个像以前一样自动选择治疗的选项。

source: - When viewing map cells with [v], information is printed for everything in that cell (not just the "top" thing) - e.g.: "I see here: A dart trap. A murky potion"
target: - 当使用 [v] 查看地图单元格时，会打印该单元格中所有内容的信息（不仅仅是“顶部”的东西） - 例如：“我在这里看到：飞镖陷阱。黑暗药水”

source: - When viewing monster descriptions ("v"), the monster's hit chances and properties are no longer displayed (only the player's chance to hit the monster)
target: - 查看怪物描述（“v”）时，不再显示怪物的击中几率和属性（仅显示玩家击中怪物的几率）

source: - When viewing monster descriptions, current health percentage is shown. Added an option to disable health bars.
target: - 查看怪物描述时，会显示当前的健康百分比。添加了禁用生命条的选项。

source: - When viewing monster descriptions, temporary negative properties are listed
target: - 查看怪物描述时，会列出临时负面属性

source: - When walking through water or mud, more descriptive messages are printed ("I wade slowly through the knee high water") instead of "splash" or "glop" - this is to emphasize that they cost an extra turn to move through
target: - 穿过水或泥地时会显示更具描述性的消息（“我缓慢涉过齐膝深的水”），不再只显示“溅水”或“咕噜”——以强调通过这些地形要额外消耗一回合

source: - While aiming aiming, the marker shows if the path goes through any seen blocking cells
target: - 瞄准时，标记会显示路径是否穿过任何可见的阻挡单元

source: - While aiming firearms or thrown weapons, the game no longer prints info about map features, items, etc in the aiming location (only info about any monster seen there)
target: - 瞄准枪械或投掷武器时，游戏不再在瞄准位置打印有关地图特征、物品等的信息（仅显示有关在那里看到的任何怪物的信息）

source: - While aiming, you are informed what you are looking at, and hit chances are shown when aiming at monsters
target: - 瞄准时，你会被告知你在看什么，瞄准怪物时会显示命中率

source: - While being entangled or stuck, it is now possible to melee attack adjacent monsters with the move direction keys (this is consistent with the nailed status, where it was already possible).
target: - 当被缠住或卡住时，现在可以使用移动方向键近战攻击相邻的怪物（这与钉住状态一致，这已经是可能的）。

source: - While holding lit explosives, the explosive is shown in the status lines instead of the selected throwing item (with yellow text)
target: - 持有点燃的炸药时，炸药会显示在状态栏中，而不是选定的投掷物品（带有黄色文本）

source: - While paralysed, the character info did not show damage taken until the player could move (now it updates for each hit)
target: - 瘫痪时，角色信息在玩家可以移动之前不会显示受到的伤害（现在每次击中都会更新）

source: - While paralyzed, additional paralyzing effects are prevented (creatures with such an attack could very easily paralyze you permanently)

source: - You are now immune to Infection while Diseased (being Infected and Diseased at the same time was redundant and annoying)

source: - You can no longer wait ('s') while you see an enemy
target: - 现在看见敌人时无法按 ('s') 等待

source: - You can now "become aware" of a monster by hearing or seeing it - this "awareness" will last for a few turns and cause the monster to be marked on the map with an exclamation mark ("!") while it is not in your view. This represents the player character listening more closely for footsteps and other small clues, and estimating where the monster could go. This feature is intended to help avoid situations like walking around a corner to get instantly killed by a shotgun blast - now you should have more opportunity to make better decisions about such things.
target: - 现在可以通过听见或看见怪物来“察觉”它。这种“察觉”会持续数回合，并在怪物不在视野内时以感叹号（“!”）标记在地图上。这表示角色会更仔细地聆听脚步声等细微线索，并估测怪物可能前往的位置。此功能旨在帮助避免拐过墙角后立即被霰弹枪击杀等情况，让你有更多机会做出更好的决策。

source: - You can now also kick in your own cell ("w", then "5" or ".") - to destroy corpses you're standing on
target: - 现在也可以踢自己所在的格子（按“w”，再按“5”或“.”），摧毁脚下的尸体。

target: - 现在可以按 [d] 并选择方向来解除陷阱（地面和箱子上的陷阱都适用）

source: - You can now only accidentally drop your melee weapon during combat if you are Cursed
target: - 现在只有受诅咒时，战斗中才会意外丢下近战武器

target: - 尝试卡住敞开的门时不再会丢失铁钉

source: - You no longer drop your items when you die

source: - You no longer pick an ability when creating a new character

source: - You now select a background when starting a game, the choices are "Occultist" (magic), "Rogue" (stealth), and "War Veteran" (fighter/firearms) - Your background determines which traits and items you start with, there are also special background-specific abilities, and some traits have background prerequisites.

target: 为精神和心智提供力量与指引的焦点。向此象征祈祷可获得 1–4 点精神值，并在 6–12 回合内抵抗震慑与恐惧。

source: A forgotten spell can be recalled again by gazing into a magic mirror, or by casting the spell from a manuscript.
target: 一个被遗忘的咒语可以通过凝视魔镜或从手稿中施展咒语来再次回忆起来。

source: A gaunt, bipedal predator bearing canine features. Dried blood mottles its snout and its claws are filthy with sodden earth and chunks of flesh.
target: 一只瘦削的双足掠食者，长着犬类特征。口鼻上沾着干涸的血，爪子上则满是湿泥和碎肉。

source: A gelatinous worm which contorts and mutates itself into different beings. Destroying the mutated form will revert the creature back to its original shape.
target: 一条胶状蠕虫，会扭曲并变形成不同生物。摧毁变异形态后，它会恢复原形。

source: A great wickedness has been extinguished.
A grotesque mummified hybrid creature, with the body of a human and the head of a crocodile. It is wielding a spear.
target: 一具怪诞的木乃伊混种生物，长着人身鳄首，手持长矛。
前方有一条骇人的道路。

source: A gruesome torture device with spikes driven into the neck of the wearer. It is impossible to take off.
target: 一种可怕的酷刑装置，其尖刺刺入佩戴者的颈部。起飞是不可能的。

source: A horrible disease is starting to afflict
target: 一种可怕的疾病开始侵袭

source: A knife specially designed and weighted so that it can be thrown effectively.
target: 一把经过专门设计和加重的刀，可以有效地投掷。
一只体型庞大的攻击性啮齿动物。

source: A large cleaver-like knife. It serves well both as a cutting tool and weapon.
target: 一把像切肉刀一样的大刀。它既可以用作切割工具，也可以用作武器。

source: A large wolf with eyes full of cunning.
target: 一头眼中透着狡黠的大狼。
一具冷之国厄运织者尸体
一具毫无生气的骇人尸体
一具毫无生气的木乃伊

source: A living incarnation of death. With its goat-like features, it is eerily similar to the imagery of Devils and Demons seen in medieval woodcuts.
target: 死亡的化身。它长着山羊般的特征，与中世纪木刻版画中恶魔的形象惊人地相似。

source: A loathsome beast hauling around a great sagging body on strained legs. Through its translucent, stretched skin the vile content of the creature's husk is clearly visible: carrion, human remains in various states of decomposition, trash, and sewage - along with other less recognizable things. Its head droops to the ground, where a tentacled mouth devours whatever filth it happens upon. It occasionally spews forth half-solid chunks of ooze, which after fermenting in the remarkable conditions of the creature's bowels, takes on a form of life of it's own - hunting for biological matter to decompose in order to feed its creator.
target: 一头令人作呕的野兽，双腿吃力地撑起松垮庞大的身躯。透过它半透明、绷紧的皮肤，可以清楚看见躯壳里恶心的内容物：腐肉、不同腐烂程度的人体残骸、垃圾和污水，以及其他难以辨认的东西。它的头垂向地面，触手状的嘴巴吞噬着遇到的一切污物。它偶尔会喷出半固态的黏液块；这些黏液在它肠腔奇异的环境中发酵后，会自行形成生命，四处寻找可分解的生物质，以供养其造物主。

source: A long staff with a forked, four-pronged end.
target: 一根长棍，末端有叉状四爪。

source: A mainspring-powered clockwork of unreal quality and beauty. When wound up, it causes the owner to move very swiftly for a brief time.
target: 一个主发条驱动的发条装置，具有不可思议的品质和美丽。当上紧发条时，它会导致所有者在短时间内快速移动。

source: A malformed cross of rat and man, birthed from witchcraft. It has a warped human face and vestigial hands for forepaws.
target: 一只由巫术孕育、畸形的鼠人混种。它长着扭曲的人脸，前爪则是退化的手。

source: A marvel of biological and technological symbiosis. The Mi-Go Bio Engineer harnesses intricate anatomical knowledge to remotely mend the wounds of its kin - through an intricate network of unseen tendrils, it channels healing energies, fostering rejuvenation from a distance. Cloaked in ethereal veils, it maneuvers undetected, an invaluable asset to the covert operations of the enigmatic Mi-Go.
target: 生物与科技共生的奇迹。米戈生物工程师凭借精妙的解剖学知识，远距离修复同族的创伤；它通过一张看不见的触须网络传导疗愈能量，使远方的同族恢复生机。它披着幽灵般的薄纱，在不被察觉的情况下行动，是神秘米戈秘密行动中不可或缺的一员。

source: A metallic device of cylindrical shape. It seems to be designed for human hands, for whatever nefarious purpose.
target: 圆柱形金属装置。它似乎是为人类的双手而设计的，无论出于什么邪恶的目的。

source: A mummified human being, possibly dating back millennia.
target: 一具可能已有数千年历史的木乃伊。

source: A mysterious humanoid figure stalking for prey. It is invisible to normal eyes.
target: 一个神秘的人形身影正在跟踪猎物，肉眼无法看见它。

source: A nasty infection that will get worse if left untreated.
target: 一种可怕的感染，若不治疗，病情会不断恶化。

source: A nightmarish creature of humanoid shape. It has a hideous gangly physique and sickly pale skin. Its arms are as long as its body is tall, and it attacks with ripping claws. It can appear anywhere it desires at any time, and can also snatch teleporting creatures from their voyage and draw them to it.
target: 一个噩梦般的人形生物。它身形瘦长畸异，皮肤苍白病态，双臂长及全身。它用撕裂般的利爪攻击，可以随心所欲地在任何时间出现在任何地点；它还能从传送途中截住其他生物，将它们拖到自己身边。

source: A nightmarish creature of humanoid shape. It has a hideous gangly physique and sickly pale skin. Its arms are as long as its body is tall, and it attacks with ripping claws. It can appear anywhere it desires at any time, and can also snatch teleporting creatures from their voyage and draw them to it. This ancient individual has learned the art of spellcasting.
target: 一个噩梦般的人形生物。它身形瘦长畸异，皮肤苍白病态，双臂长及全身。它用撕裂般的利爪攻击，可以随心所欲地在任何时间出现在任何地点；它还能从传送途中截住其他生物，将它们拖到自己身边。这个古老个体已掌握施法之术。

source: A one piece overall of asbestos fabric, including a hood, furnace mask, gloves and shoes.
target: 一件式石棉织物，包括头罩、炉面罩、手套和鞋子。

source: A pack of rats appear around the caster.
target: 一群老鼠出现在施法者周围。

source: A particularly nasty disembodied hand, crawling around frantically on its fingertips like a spider. Beware of the Thing.
target: 一只格外可怕的身首分离之手，正用指尖像蜘蛛一样慌乱爬行。小心那东西。

source: A peculiar floating speck of strange shifting colors. It is very confusing to look at. Wherever they pass, they corrupt the environment around them. They are invulnerable to attacks from common materials like iron or steel, but can be destroyed by other forms of damage, such as fire or electricity.
target: 一粒奇异的浮空斑点，颜色不断变幻，看久了会令人极度困惑。它经过之处，周围环境都会被腐化。普通的铁或钢制攻击无法伤害它，但火焰、电击等其他伤害可以摧毁它。

source: A perpetual curse was put upon me
target: 我被施加了一个永恒的诅咒

source: A pitch black dagger with elaborate ornaments. The blade appears blurry, as if perpetually covered in a dark haze.
target: 一把漆黑的匕首，上面有精致的装饰。剑刃看起来模糊不清，仿佛永远笼罩在黑暗的薄雾之中。

source: A plea for mercy from realms beyond.
target: 一声来自异界的恳求，祈求怜悯。

source: A pole weapon consisting of a wooden shaft and a steel head.
target: 一种由木柄和钢头组成的长杆武器。

source: A portable bag of medical supplies. Can be used to treat Wounds or Infections.
target: 一个装有医疗用品的便携式袋子。可用于治疗创伤或感染。

source: A powerful wind is pulling me!
target: 一股强风正把我往前拉!

source: A predacious worm about the size of an adult human's arm. Its bite causes heavy disorientation in the victim.
target: 一条掠食性蠕虫，粗细约有成年人的手臂那么大。它的咬击会令受害者严重迷乱。

source: A product of all that has festered in forgotten vaults for untold ages. It exudes a mephitic cloud stemming from the unknown chemical processes that are constantly occurring within it. A malodorous broth of purulence bubbles about its nucleus, indicating it is ridden with disease.
target: 它是被遗忘的地窖中无数年代以来腐败之物的产物。它不断散发恶臭云雾，源自体内持续发生的未知化学反应。其核心周围翻滚着一锅恶臭的脓液，显然早已染病。

source: A product of all that has festered in forgotten vaults for untold ages. It exudes a mephitic cloud stemming from the unknown chemical processes that are constantly occurring within it. The alarmingly green hue of this particular specimen indicates its utter venomousness.
target: 它是被遗忘的地窖中无数年代以来腐败之物的产物。它不断散发恶臭云雾，源自体内持续发生的未知化学反应。这个个体令人不安的翠绿色，表明它具有极强毒性。

source: A product of all that has festered in forgotten vaults for untold ages. It exudes a mephitic cloud stemming from the unknown chemical processes that are constantly occurring within it. This species has developed a trait that allows it to mimic the colors of its surroundings, rendering it nearly invisible to its prey.
target: 它是被遗忘的地窖中无数年代以来腐败之物的产物。它不断散发恶臭云雾，源自体内持续发生的未知化学反应。这个物种进化出模仿周围颜色的特质，几乎能在猎物面前隐形。

source: A prophecy foretelling the end of all things.
target: 一则预言，预示万物终结。

source: A protective carapace forms around me.
target: 一层保护性甲壳在我周围形成。

source: A pump-action shotgun has a handgrip that can be pumped back and forth in order to eject a spent round of ammunition and to chamber a fresh one. It has a single barrel above a tube magazine into which shells are inserted. The magazine has a capacity of 8 shells.
target: 泵动式霰弹枪有一个可以前后泵动的手柄，以便弹出用完的弹药并装入新的弹药。它在管状弹匣上方有一个枪管，炮弹可插入其中。该弹匣容量为8发。

source: A ropy, winged worm of vast size and vaporous composition. Brought forth from another plane of existence it drifts in endless search of sustenance, its maw hanging so agape it could swallow an ox whole.
target: 一条巨大的绳状翼虫，身躯由雾气构成。它从另一个位面被召来，无休止地漂游觅食；张开的巨口足以吞下一整头牛。

source: A semi-automatic, magazine-fed pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge.
target: 半自动弹匣供弹手枪，可装 0.45 ACP 子弹。

source: A severed head floating through the air.
target: 一颗在空中漂浮的断头。

source: A shambling thing which could be taken for a man were it not for its briny whiff and scaly skin. Slits on its neck emit a labored inflection, marking its struggle to gulp at breathable air. It hoists a rust-eaten spear and a net through which the thrashing remains of its last feast can be seen.
target: 一个摇摇晃晃的东西，若不是那股咸腥味和鳞片皮肤，几乎可以当成人。它颈部的裂缝发出艰难的呼吸声，显出它努力汲取空气的挣扎。它扛着一支锈蚀的长矛和一张网，网中还挂着它上一顿猎物挣扎的残骸。

source: A sheet steel cylinder with emission holes releasing smoke when the grenade is ignited. Their primary use is to create smoke screens for concealment. The fumes produced can harm the eyes, throat and lungs - so it is recommended to wear a protective mask.
target: 带有发射孔的钢板圆筒，当手榴弹被点燃时会释放烟雾。它们的主要用途是制造烟幕以进行隐蔽。产生的烟雾会伤害眼睛、喉咙和肺部——因此建议佩戴防护面罩。

source: A short transcription of an eldritch incantation. There is a strange aura about it, as if some power was imbued in the paper itself.
target: 一段可怕咒语的简短转录。上面有一种奇异的气息，仿佛纸张本身蕴含着某种力量。

source: A shrivelled hag who croaks of deviltry and possesses knowledge beyond the ken of a sane mind. She reigns over the myriad man-rat hybrids crawling within the dungeon, humoring her most cherished like a child: not once does she deny it the black blood that flows inside her veins.
target: 一名干瘪的老巫婆，呱呱地谈论恶魔之事，掌握着常人无法理解的知识。她统治着地牢中无数鼠人混种，像宠爱孩子般纵容最珍爱的那一个：她从不吝惜那体内流淌的黑血。

source: A shroud of vapor envelops me.
A sickly growth thriving in damp areas. It produces toxic spores which it stores in its slimy heads.
target: 一种在潮湿处繁茂生长的病态菌类。它会产生毒孢子，并将其储存在黏滑的菌帽中。

source: A sickly growth thriving in damp areas. It produces toxic spores which it stores in its slimy heads. Almost invisible to the naked eye, it spreads like a creeping pestilence.
target: 一种在潮湿处繁茂生长的病态菌类。它会产生毒孢子，并将其储存在黏滑的菌帽中。它几乎肉眼难辨，像蔓延的瘟疫般扩散。

source: A sickly growth thriving in damp areas. The toxic spores of this particular species are strongly hallucinogenic.
target: 一种在潮湿处繁茂生长的病态菌类。这个物种的毒孢子具有极强的致幻性。

source: A slithering conglomeration of carnivorous worms.
A small axe with a short handle. Hatchets are reliable weapons - they are easy to use, and cause decent damage for their low weight.
target: 短柄小斧头。斧头是可靠的武器 - 它们易于使用，并且重量轻，可造成相当大的伤害。

source: A small cave-dwelling humanoid. Their mouths are set with rows of serrated teeth, well-adapted for cutting through flesh. However, they are cowardly opportunistic creatures, preferring to stalk lonely prey that they perceive as an easy target - when met with violence, they will usually retreat, at least for a moment.
target: 一种栖居洞穴的小型人形生物。它们嘴里长着一排排锯齿状牙齿，适合撕开血肉。不过它们胆怯而投机，偏爱跟踪落单、看似容易下手的猎物；一旦遭遇暴力，通常会暂时撤退。

source: A small glass bottle containing a mysterious concoction.
target: 一个小玻璃瓶，里面装有神秘的混合物。

source: A small piece of machinery. It could not possibly have been designed by a human mind. Even for its small size, it seems incredibly complex. There is no hope of understanding the purpose or function of it through normal means.
target: 一个小机械。它不可能是由人类大脑设计的。尽管它的尺寸很小，但它看起来却非常复杂。通过正常手段是无法了解其目的或功能的。

source: A spinning force of fire and destruction.
target: 一股旋转的火焰与毁灭之力。

source: A spinning force of pure energy.
target: 一股纯能量构成的旋转之力。

source:
A status effect has been applied. Status effects are various positive, negative or neutral effects applied on a creature. Some examples are confusion, burning, invisibility, or electricity resistance. A simple list of active status effects is shown in the normal game screen. 

In the character screen (accessed by pressing [C] or [@]), a more detailed list can be seen, including a description of each effect. 

Status effects shown with CAPITAL LETTERS are "permanent", and are only removed if some special action is taken, for example using the medical bag to treat a wound.
target:
已施加一种状态效果。状态效果是施加于生物身上的正面、负面或中性效果，例如困惑、燃烧、隐形或电击抗性。游戏主画面会简单列出当前生效的状态效果。

在角色界面（按 [C] 或 [@] 打开）中，可以查看更详细的列表及每种效果的说明。

以大写字母显示的状态效果属于“永久”效果，只有采取某些特殊行动才会移除，例如使用医疗包治疗创伤。

source: A tentacled alien creature, mysteriously floating through the air in a ghostly manner. They somehow sustain themselves on the brain activity of other beings. This will usually not kill the victim, but the experience is horrific beyond words. They only feed on sound minds however - a strange or chaotic mind will cause them great distress.
target: 一种长着触手、神秘地如幽灵般漂浮在空中的外星生物。它们靠其他生物的脑活动维生。这通常不会杀死受害者，但过程可怕得难以言喻。不过它们只以健全的心智为食；奇异或混乱的心智会令它们极度痛苦。

source: A terrible curse was lifted from me
target: 一个可怕的诅咒从我身上解除

source: A tool intended for felling trees, splitting timber, etc. Used as a weapon it can deliver devastating blows, although it requires some skill to use effectively.
target: 一种用于砍伐树木、劈木等的工具。用作武器时，它可以造成毁灭性的打击，但需要一定的技巧才能有效使用。

source: A type of pyrotechnic that produces a brilliant light or intense heat without an explosion.
target: 一种烟火，能产生明亮的光或强烈的热量而不爆炸。

source: A vaguely intelligent floating fungus-based organism. It contains a highly explosive gas and will detonate very easily, which it seems to desire.
target: 一种略有智能的浮空真菌生物。它体内含有极易引爆的气体，而且似乎很乐意引爆。

source: A vast, fully matured Khaga, the flight of this cryptic being conceals it from ordinary eyesight. It wails a disarmingly beautiful mantra which dissonates with the roar of the bolts it summons from its orb-like head.
target: 一只完全成熟的巨大卡哈加。这个神秘生物能飞行，普通视力无法看见它。它发出迷人而动听的咏唱，与它从球状头部召来的雷霆轰鸣格格不入。

source: A very strange and crude weapon capable of launching iron spikes with enough force to pierce flesh (or even rock). It seems almost to be deliberately designed for cruelty, rather than pure stopping power.
target: 一种非常奇怪和粗糙的武器，能够发射铁钉，其力量足以刺穿肉体（甚至岩石）。它似乎是为了残酷而故意设计的，而不是纯粹的制止力量。

source: A vile dwarfish creature, clad in coarse brown robes. It has a cruel grin on its pale face, and its eyes are gleaming with hatred. The Bog Tcher are mechanically inclined, which they put to use by crafting sadistic weapons and traps. Their favored weapon is their "spike gun", which can pin the target against solid objects for prolonged suffering.
target: 一只矮小邪恶的生物，身披粗糙的棕色长袍。它苍白的脸上挂着残忍的笑容，眼中闪烁着仇恨。沼泽特切尔擅长机械技艺，并将其用于制作残酷的武器和陷阱。它们最喜欢的武器是“尖刺枪”，能把目标钉在坚硬物体上，让其长期受苦。

source: A voice is calling forth Tomb-Legions!
target: 有个声音正在召唤墓穴军团!

source: A voice is stirring up a great frenzy!
target: 一个声音正在掀起一阵狂乱！

source: A walking cadaver of towering proportions, it seems to have had the skin of countless other bodies poorly sewn over that of its own. Festering wounds on its hulk continually disgorge a putrid liquid.
target: 一具高大得惊人的行尸，似乎有人把无数其他尸体的皮肤胡乱缝在它身上。它庞大的身躯上遍布溃烂创口，不断涌出腐臭液体。

source: A weapon created by the Mi-Go. It fires devastating bolts of electricity.
target: Mi-Go 创造的武器。它会发射毁灭性的闪电。

source: A weapon created by the Mi-Go. It launches projectiles that unleash explosive energy upon impact. The weapon adapts itself to merge with the biology of its wielder. A guidance system integrates with the brain to ensure that the projectile hits its intended mark independent of aiming skill (although there is a small chance that it collides with unintended targets along the path).
target: Mi-Go 创造的武器。它发射的射弹在撞击时会释放爆炸性能量。该武器会自我调整以融入其使用者的生物学特征。制导系统与大脑集成，以确保弹丸击中预定目标，而与瞄准技能无关（尽管它沿着路径与意外目标发生碰撞的可能性很小）。

source: A writhing mass of crawling intestines.

Addicted to Astral Opium - the addiction will cease eventually if Astral Opium is not used again, however the abstinence will soon cause withdrawal symptoms (increased minimum shock). The addiction is too powerful and otherwordly to be cured by a Potion of Fortitude.
target: 沉溺于星界鸦片——若不再使用星界鸦片，成瘾最终会消退；但戒断很快会引发症状（最低震慑值上升）。这种成瘾力量过于强大、过于异界，坚毅药水也无法治愈。
影响所有可见的敌对生物。

source: Affects one random visible hostile creature.
target: 影响一名随机可见的敌对生物。

source: After each game is finished, information such as player name and dungeon level reached is stored in a "memorial file" on the disk, and a high score entry is added (unless you manually quit the game by pressing "Q"). The high score list can be viewed by selecting the main menu option "Graveyard". Selecting a high score entry on this screen will show the corresponding stored memorial file.
target: 每局游戏结束后，玩家名称、抵达的地牢层数等信息都会写入磁盘上的“纪念档案”，并新增一条高分记录（手动按“Q”退出时除外）。可从主菜单选择“墓园”查看高分榜。在此界面选择一条记录，即可查看对应的纪念档案。

source: Agata Skrzypczyk - Contributed a gorgeous logo and icon.
target: Agata Skrzypczyk——贡献了精美的标志和图标。

source:
As I make my way into the depths, I'm taken aback by the sudden change in surroundings. The ancient architecture of this chamber is unlike anything I've seen before, with intricate hieroglyphs carved into the stone walls.

The air is thick with the scent of sand and an unfamiliar incense, giving the impression of being transported to another time and place. The silence is oppressive, broken only by the sound of my footsteps echoing on the stone floor.

As I look closer at the carvings, I can't help but wonder about the civilization that created them. Who were they, and how did they manage to build something like this deep underground?
target:
我继续深入，却被周围环境的骤变惊住了。这间石室的古老建筑风格前所未见，石墙上刻着精美的象形文字。

空气中弥漫着沙土和陌生熏香的气味，仿佛置身于另一个时空。沉闷的寂静令人窒息，只有我的脚步声在石地上回荡。

我凑近观察那些刻纹，不禁好奇究竟是哪个文明创造了它们。他们是谁？又如何在如此深的地下建造出这种地方？

According to the writings of the former, she took the throne by inviting her brother's murderers to a banquet. Then killed them by flooding the sealed room with the Nile.
target: 尼托克丽丝木乃伊——第六王朝的埃及女法老。无人知晓她为何会来到此处。她的名字见于希罗多德的史书和曼涅托的著作。据后者记载，她邀请谋杀兄长的人赴宴，再将尼罗河水灌入密室将他们淹死。

source: The next spell is cast without spending a turn, and the cost is reduced by 1 point.
target: 下一个法术无需消耗一个回合即可施放，且消耗减少 1 点。

source: The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear, and the oldest and strongest kind of fear is fear of the unknown.
target: “人类最古老、最强烈的情感是恐惧，而最古老、最强烈的恐惧，是对未知的恐惧。”

source: The Omega Sentinel, a dreadful creation of the Mi-Go, stands as a testament to their technological mastery. Its chitinous form melds organic and mechanical elements seamlessly, emanating an aura of awe-inspiring terror. Armed with a devastating weapon, it guards the hidden operations of the Mi-Go with unwavering resolve.
target: 欧米伽哨卫是米戈创造的可怖造物，彰显着他们高超的科技造诣。它的甲壳形态将有机与机械元素无缝融合，散发出令人敬畏的恐怖气息。它装备着毁灭性武器，坚定地守卫着米戈的隐秘行动。

source: the owner is harmed by light.

The properties at the bottom can be temporary properties (e.g. from spells), PERMANENT intrinsic properties (printed in capital letters, e.g. "CURSED"), or properties granted by wearing or wielding items.
target: 底部列出的属性可能是临时属性（例如来自法术）、永久固有属性（以大写字母显示，例如“CURSED”），或穿戴、手持物品赋予的属性。

source: The rats are ethereal (much harder to hit with attacks, can move through solid objects), are immune to magic, can cast spells, and have +4 hit points and +3 maximum damage.
target: 老鼠是空灵的（更难被攻击击中，可以穿过固体物体移动），对魔法免疫，可以施法，并且有+4生命值和+3最大伤害。
老鼠是加速的（移动得更快）。

source: The sanctity of this place has been somewhat restored.
target: 这个地方的神圣性已经有所恢复。

source: The sciences have hitherto harmed us little; but some day the piecing together of dissociated knowledge will open up such terrifying vistas of reality, that we shall either go mad from the revelation or flee from the deadly light into the peace and safety of a new dark age.
target: “迄今为止，科学对我们的危害甚微；但终有一天，彼此分离的知识拼合起来，将揭开如此骇人的现实图景：我们要么因真相而疯狂，要么逃离这致命之光，躲进新的黑暗时代，求得安宁与安全。”

source: The senses cannot always be trusted.
The Shadow in the Crimson Light
The shadows are closing in on me!
The shotgun has a capacity of two shells, and you load one shell at a time. Cultits reload their shotgun when they need to.
target: 霰弹枪可装两发弹药，每次装填一发。邪教徒需要时会为霰弹枪装填弹药。

source: The Sound of the Deep Waters
The spell can be cast at
The state of your physical health is described in two ways:
target: 你的身体健康状况通过两种方式描述：

source: The Supreme Wizard of the Cult of Starry Wisdom. He appears incredibly old, like a hideous ancient vampire or a grim reaper. Tattered crimson robes flow from his skeletal frame, his bony fingers extends into razor sharp claws, and he has a grim expression on his face.
target: 星辰智慧教团的大巫师。他看起来极其年迈，宛如一只可怖的古老吸血鬼或冷酷的死神。破烂的深红长袍垂挂在他骨瘦如柴的身躯上，骨指化作锋利的爪子，脸上满是阴沉神情。

source: The surrounding area suddenly burst into flames!
target: 周围顿时熊熊燃烧起来！

source: The tale of a lost civilization's final days.
target: 失落文明末日时日的故事。

source:
The walls here are slick with dampness, and the air is heavy with the stench of saltwater and the unmistakable odor of decay. I can feel the humidity on my skin, and my breaths come out in shallow gasps. 

There are tunnels leading deeper into underground waterways, but I can only guess where they might lead. It's as if the entire cave system is interconnected, with passages that could possibly lead to the depths of the ocean or subterranean lakes and rivers.
target:
这里的墙壁湿滑，空气中弥漫着沉重的盐水与腐朽气息。我能感到皮肤上的湿气，呼吸也变得短促。

有隧道通往更深处的地下水道，但我只能猜测它们通向何方。整个洞穴系统似乎彼此相连，通道也许会通往海洋深处，或地下湖泊与河流。

source: The weapon in this example is a firearm, "5/6" is the
target: 此例中的武器是枪械，“5/6”表示

source: The weapons can see invisible creatures.
target: 这些武器可以看到隐形生物。

source: The weapons cannot be harmed by physical damage.
target: 这些武器不会受到物理伤害。

source: The webs spun by this transcendental creature are not of any mundane kind - weaving, plucking, gnawing, it taps directly into the fabric of fate, making baleful arrangements according to its ulterior whims.
target: 这超凡生物织出的蛛网绝非凡物——它编织、拨弄、啃噬，直接触及命运的织布，并依循隐秘私欲，编排出不祥的结局。

source: The work of Oryx can be found here: https://www.oryxdesignlab.com/
There are also other ways you can lose Spirit, for example some monsters can drain your Spirit with their attacks.
target: 你也可能因其他原因失去精神值，例如有些怪物的攻击会汲取精神力。

source: There are black zones of shadow close to our daily paths, and now and then some evil soul breaks a passage through. When that happens, the man who knows must strike before reckoning the consequences.
target: 在我们日常行经之处附近，潜藏着黑暗的阴影区域；偶尔会有邪恶灵魂打通一道通路。一旦如此，知情者必须在考量后果之前先行出手。

source: There are horrors beyond life's edge that we do not suspect, and once in a while man's evil prying calls them just within our range.
target: 生命边界之外潜藏着我们未曾察觉的恐怖；偶尔，人类邪恶的窥探会将它们引到我们身边。

source: There are no minor injuries to patch up.
There are no more items of interest.
target: 没有更多值得关注的物品了。

source: There is a briny smell here.
There is a carved rock defiled with blasphemous carvings here. It must be destroyed!
target: 这里有块刻着亵渎图案的石头。必须摧毁它！

source: There is a carved rock here.
There is a fountain here, but it's dried-up.
target: 这里有一座喷泉，不过已经干涸了。

source: There is a glass surface here.
There is a half-dissolved human body inside!
target: 里面有一具半溶解的人体！

source: There is a loud whistling sound.
There is a price for this however, since it causes intense hallucinogenic delusions, and it is also severely addictive.
target: 然而，这是有代价的，因为它会引起强烈的致幻妄想，而且还会严重上瘾。

source: There is a sharp droning in my head!
target: 我的脑袋里传来尖锐的嗡嗡声！

source: There is a stench of decayed flesh here.
There is a stone box here.
There is a strange itch, as if something is crawling on the back of my neck.
target: 我感到一阵奇痒，仿佛有什么东西正在脖颈后面爬动。

source: There is a temple gong here.
There is a vague change in the air.
target: 空气中出现了隐约的变化。

source: There is an alchemist's workbench here.
target: 这里有一张炼金术士的工作台。

source:
There is an inscription here, studying it will yield some experience.

It may also recall a spell that you have forgotten, or reveal something about carried manuscripts or potions. The chance to reveal information about such items is higher with more unknown items carried.
target:
这里有一段铭文，研究它可以获得一些经验。

它还可能让你回忆起遗忘的法术，或揭示随身携带的手稿、药水的信息。你携带的未知物品越多，揭示这类信息的几率就越高。

source: There is an intense flash of light!

There is an item called a "Medical Bag", which has a certain number of "supplies". When activated, it can be used to either sanitize an infection, treat a WOUND, or do a quick patch-up that restores some Hit Points. When bitten or clawed by certain monsters, you can become Infected; This should be treated before the infection turns into a disease! Treating infections or doing a quick patch-up only require a few supplies, while treating wounds requires more.
target: 有一种叫作“医疗包”的物品，内含一定数量的“补给”。启动后可用于消毒感染、治疗创伤，或快速包扎以恢复一些生命值。被某些怪物咬伤或抓伤后可能会感染；必须在感染发展成疾病前进行治疗！治疗感染或快速包扎只需少量补给，治疗创伤则需要更多。

source: There is nothing more to shed.
target: 没有什么可以流掉的了。

source: There is nothing of value inside.
There is suddenly a crushing pressure in the air!
target: 空气中骤然出现一股沉重的压迫感！

source: They are very flammable, and will quickly ignite other nearby flammable creatures
target: 它们极易燃烧，也会迅速点燃附近其他可燃生物

source: They cannot visually detect other creatures
target: 它们无法通过视觉发现其他生物

source: They emit light and can be seen in darkness
target: 它们会发光，即使在黑暗中也能被看见
它们会随时间恢复生命值

source: They worshipped, so they said, the Great Old Ones who lived ages before there were any men, and who came to the young world out of the sky...
target: 据说他们崇拜远古众神——那些在人类出现很久以前便已存在、从天而降来到这个年轻世界的古老存在……

source: This device is completely alien to me, I could never understand it through normal means.
target: 这个装置对我来说完全陌生，我无法通过正常方式理解它。

source: This elixir fully restores all hit points, heals all wounds, and cures blindness, deafness, poisoning, infections, disease, weakening, and life sapping. Also, for some duration after consuming the potion, +1 extra hit point is healed per turn, and there is 10% chance per turn to heal one wound.
target: 这种灵药可完全恢复生命值、治愈所有创伤，并治愈失明、失聪、中毒、感染、疾病、虚弱和生命流失。此外，服用后的一段时间内，每回合额外恢复 1 点生命值，而且每回合有 10% 几率治愈一处创伤。

source: This evil artifact must be destroyed!
target: 必须摧毁这件邪恶神器！

source: This former corpse has been granted a twisted gift of wings, resembling those of a monstrous bat. Awkward and ungainly in its newfound aerial ability, it navigates the air with unsteady movements. Despite its diminished agility and imprecise strikes, this abomination remains a formidable threat, driven by an insatiable hunger for the living.
target: 这具旧尸体被赋予了一双扭曲的翅膀，形似巨蝠。它刚获得飞行能力，动作笨拙而不协调，只能在空中摇摇晃晃地移动。尽管灵活性下降、攻击也不精准，这个怪物依然极具威胁，因为它对活物有着永不满足的饥渴。

source: This is merely a convenience feature - you can just as well use items by selecting them from the "i" screen, but with this method you get a nice filtered list so you can see at a glance which consumables you have.
target: 这只是方便功能——你也可以从“i”界面选择物品使用；但通过此方式会显示筛选后的列表，让你一眼看清自己有哪些消耗品。

source: This is the dreaded Necronomicon - the Book of the Dead! Its pages contain much dire knowledge on esoteric matters. While carried, all spells are cast at a higher skill level, and it is possible to reach a fourth level, "Transcendent".
target: 这就是可怕的《死灵之书》——死亡之书！它的页面包含许多关于深奥问题的可怕知识。携带时，所有法术都会以更高的技能等级施展，并且有可能达到第四级“超凡”。

source: This living fossil appears to have crept unchanged from the dawn of time through untold millions of years. Both a predator and a scavenger, it bites and tears with voracious jaws.
target: 这块活化石似乎从时间的黎明起便一成不变地爬行了数百万年。它既是捕食者也是食腐动物，会用贪婪的颚齿撕咬猎物。

source: This man-rodent beast slinks through cracks in the church's walls and pounces on its victims, raking at their flesh with its undeveloped limbs. Being the black matron's mongrel of choice, it titters senselessly whenever it feasts on her blood.
target: 这个人鼠混种会从教堂墙壁的裂缝中悄然溜出，扑向受害者，用尚未发育完全的肢体抓挠血肉。它是黑色母亲最中意的杂种，每当吸食她的血液时便会傻笑。

source: This miserable thing was a failed attempt at the reanimation of dead flesh. Perhaps necrosis had advanced too far before the process started, or this was a wild experiment performed by one who lacked proper knowledge of the principles involved. It lumbers about aimlessly with a vacant expression, which gives it something of a calm appearance - although the twitch in its clawed fingers is something to be wary of.
target: 这可怜的东西是复活尸体的失败尝试。也许是开始仪式前尸体已经严重坏死，或是操作者缺乏必要知识而胡乱实验。它茫然地漫无目的游荡，表情空洞，看起来颇为平静——不过那带爪手指的抽搐仍值得警惕。

source: This place feels more serene now.
target: 这个地方现在感觉更加宁静了。

source: This powerful charm brings the owner back to life upon bodily death. The talisman is destroyed in the process however, so one may only be brought back once.
target: 这种强大的魅力可以使主人在身体死亡后复活。然而，护身符在此过程中被破坏，因此只能被带回来一次。

source: This progress is called experience, or "XP"

This represents minor injuries such as bruises, sprains, or light bleeding - and also general combat morale, fatigue, stance, etc. If your Hit Points reach 0, it means you received a killing blow, or the circumstances are such that you can no longer fight back (you are fallen, pinned or completely exhausted). Hit Points usually regenerate automatically over time.
target: 这表示瘀伤、扭伤、轻微流血等小伤，以及总体战斗士气、疲劳、姿势等状态。如果生命值降至0，说明你受到了致命一击，或已经倒地、被压制、精疲力竭，无法继续战斗。生命值通常会随时间自动恢复。

source: This represents more serious long-term damage. Wounds are received when you take a high amount of damage in one hit. Each Wound reduces your fighting abilities, maximum HP, and HP regeneration rate. Five concurrent wounds results in death.
target: 这表示更严重的长期损伤。一次受到大量伤害时会产生创伤。每处创伤都会削弱战斗能力、降低生命值上限和生命值恢复速度。同时有五处创伤就会死亡。

source: This rock is defiled with blasphemous carvings, it must be destroyed!
target: 这块石头刻有亵渎图案，必须摧毁！

source: This rotting thing appears to have been brought back to life through some abominable process. It has grown sharp claws to attack with.
target: 这个腐烂的东西似乎通过某种可憎的手段死而复生。它长出了锋利的爪子用于攻击。

source: This spell can be cast silently.
target: 这个咒语可以无声地施展。

source: This strange concoction causes a sudden flash of intuition.
target: 这种奇怪的混合物引起了直觉的突然闪现。

source: This sub-species has adapted to thriving in particularly deep environments where very little light reaches. They are even more fierce than their counterparts who dwell closer to the surface. Their mouths are set with rows of serrated teeth, well-adapted for cutting through flesh. However, they are cowardly opportunistic creatures, prefering to stalk lonely prey that they perceive as an easy target - when met with violence, they will usually retreat, at least for a moment.
target: 这个亚种适应了几乎没有光线的极深环境，比栖居在较浅处的同类更加凶猛。它们的口中长满锯齿，善于撕裂血肉。然而它们生性怯懦，只会伏击孤独且容易下手的猎物；一旦遭遇反抗，通常就会暂时撤退。

source: This unholy instrument must be destroyed!
target: 必须摧毁这件亵渎圣物！

source: This weapon can be used for
This weapon does not use ammo.
This weapon has a long reach, press [f] to attack further away.
target: 该武器射程较远，按[f]可以攻击更远的地方。

source: This weapon has an accuracy penalty at close ranges.
target: 该武器在近距离时精度会受到影响。

source: Through ardous suffering, the caster tempers their body to resist physical force (cannot be harmed by normal attacks, however other forms of damage such as fire is still harmful).
target: 施法者通过艰苦的痛苦磨练自己的身体以抵抗物理力量（普通攻击不会受到伤害，但其他形式的伤害（例如火焰）仍然会造成伤害）。

source: To add fonts, place them in this directory.
target: 要添加字体，请将其放入此目录。

target: to be defined, but it was not found

source: To cast memorized spells, press "x" to open a menu for selecting which spell to cast. In this menu you can see the Spirit cost per spell (the cost is a range of values, and the spirit drained is a random value in this range), and your skill level for each spell (Occultist characters can learn to cast spells at higher levels by picking certain traits).
target: 若要施放记忆中的法术，按“x”打开法术选择菜单。在菜单中可以查看每个法术消耗的精神值（消耗是一个范围，实际汲取量会在范围内随机决定）以及对应的技能等级（神秘学者角色可通过选择某些特质提升法术等级）。

source: To my alarm, I find myself encouraged by the pain I cause in others. For every significant life I take, I find a little relief. However, my depraved mind will never find complete peace.
target: 令我惊恐的是，我发现自己竟从造成他人痛苦中得到鼓舞。每夺去一个重要生命，我都会感到一丝宽慰。然而，我堕落的心智永远无法获得彻底平静。

target: 乌拉加是不死的欺诈与刺杀大师，受命永恒守卫大祭司。

target: 使用自动选择（优先尝试硬件加速，失败时回退到软件渲染），或强制使用软件渲染。如果遇到图像问题，将此选项设为“软件”可能会解决问题。

target: 使用默认输入模式（数字键盘或方向键），或使用“Vi 键”。详情请参阅游戏手册。

target: 使用图块图像表示游戏环境；关闭后仅使用文本符号。

target: 使用医疗器材只需一半时间与补给

target: v         查看地图上物体的描述

source: Victims struck by its flesh-tearing bite may be paralyzed with pain (20% chance).
target: 被它撕裂血肉的咬击击中后，受害者可能会因疼痛而瘫痪（20% 几率）。

source: Visions of alchemical symbols glowing with the promise of arcane revelations.
target: 炼金符号闪烁，许诺揭示奥术奥秘的幻象。

source: Vrka is a monstrous wolf-like creature dwelling in the High Priest's chambers, serving as a guardian.
target: 弗尔卡是栖居于大祭司房间中的巨狼般怪物，担任守卫。

source: Walking does not spend any time, but every step taken drains 2 hit points (waiting in place can still be done as normal). The effect ends after a certain number of steps have been taken, or if there is not enough hit points to drain.
target: 行走不消耗时间，但每走一步都会消耗 2 点生命值（原地等待仍照常进行）。走过一定步数后，或生命值不足以继续扣除时，效果结束。

source: Walking with the collar requires extra turns, and stealth and evasion are reduced by 20%. However, wearing the collar hardens the Flagellant against physical suffering, armor is increased by 3 points.
target: 佩戴项圈行走需要额外回合，潜行和闪避各降低 20%。不过，项圈能让鞭笞者更能忍受肉体痛苦，护甲值增加 3 点。

source: Warn before drinking potions that are known to be malignant.
target: 饮用已知有害的药水前发出警告。
点燃爆炸物前发出警告

source: Warn before throwing "valuable" items such as potions.
target: 投掷药水等“贵重”物品前发出警告。

source: Warn if attempting to perform a close combat melee attack with a ranged weapon (such as a pistol), which is possible but perhaps unintended.
target: 尝试用远程武器（如手枪）进行近战攻击时发出警告；虽然可以这样做，但可能并非本意。
用远程武器进行近战时警告

source: Was brought back from the dead
Was cured from a horrible disease
We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far.
target: 我们生活在一座宁静的无知小岛上，四周是无边黑暗的海洋；我们本不该远航。

source: weakening, poisoning, infection and disease are cured.
target: 虚弱、中毒、感染和疾病得到治愈。

source: weakening, poisoning, infection, disease and slowing are cured.
target: 虚弱、中毒、感染、疾病和减速被治愈。

source: weakening, poisoning, infection, disease and slowing are cured. The caster is also blessed for
target: 虚弱、中毒、感染、疾病和减速被治愈。施法者也受到祝福
武器已装填弹药数及最大弹药量

source: Wears a torture collar which cannot be taken off; walking requires extra turns, and stealth and evasion are reduced by 20%. However, wearing the collar hardens the Flagellant against physical suffering, armor is increased by 3 points.
target: 戴着无法取下的刑具项圈；行走需要额外回合，潜行与闪避降低20%。然而，项圈令苦修者更能忍受肉体痛苦，护甲提高3点。
重量          40%：携带物品造成的负重

source: What I learned and saw in those hours of impious exploration can never be told, for want of symbols or suggestions in any language.
target: 那些亵渎探索时光中我学到和见到的一切，永远无法用任何语言中的符号或暗示讲述出来。

source: When activated, this device alters the atmosphere in order to cover the user in a dense mist. The mist is also strangely soothing (-10% temporary shock).
target: 启动后，装置会改变周围气氛，以浓雾笼罩使用者。雾气还会带来奇异的舒缓效果（临时震慑 -10%）。

source: When activated, this device blasts one visible hostile creature with infernal power.
target: 激活后，该装置会用地狱之力爆炸一个可见的敌对生物。

source: When activated, this device breaks the user free from any bonds (entangled, stuck, nailed), and ends slowing.
target: 当激活时，该装置使用户摆脱任何束缚（纠缠、卡住、钉住），并结束减速。

source: When activated, this device causes temporary deafness in all creatures in a large area, except for the user.
target: 激活后，该装置会导致大范围内除使用者外的所有生物暂时失聪。

source: When activated, this device clouds the memories of all creatures in the area, causing them to forget the presence of the user.
target: 当激活时，该装置会掩盖该区域所有生物的记忆，导致它们忘记用户的存在。

source: When activated, this device constructs a temporary opaque barrier around the user, blocking all physical matter. The barrier can only be created in empty spaces (i.e. not in spaces occupied by creatures, walls, etc).
target: 激活后，该设备会在用户周围构建一个临时的不透明屏障，阻挡所有物理物质。屏障只能在空的空间中创建（即不能在被生物、墙壁等占据的空间中）。

source: When activated, this device generates a shock wave which violently pushes away any adjacent creatures and destroys structures.
target: 当激活时，该装置会产生冲击波，猛烈地推开任何相邻的生物并摧毁建筑物。

source: When activated, this device heals all wounds and physical maladies. The procedure is very painful and invasive however, and causes great shock to the user.
target: 启动后，该装置会治愈所有创伤和身体疾病。不过，治疗过程非常痛苦且具有侵入性，会给使用者造成强烈震慑。

source: When activated, this device materializes an entryway somewhere in an adjacent surface.
target: 当激活时，该装置会在相邻表面的某处实体化入口。

source: When activated, this device moves the user a short distance.
target: 激活后，该设备会将用户移动一小段距离。

source: When activated, this device opens all locks, lids and doors in the surrounding area (except heavy doors operated externally by a switch).
target: 激活后，该设备会打开周围区域的所有锁、盖子和门（通过开关从外部操作的重型门除外）。

source: When activated, this device selects a single nearby seen creature, and attempts to hypnotize it, putting them to sleep if susceptible. It is unknown how the target selection works.
target: 激活后，该设备会选择附近看到的一个生物，并尝试对其进行催眠，如果易受影响，则将其置于睡眠状态。目前尚不清楚目标选择是如何进行的。

source: When activated, this device teleports all visible enemies to different locations.
target: 激活后，该设备会将所有可见的敌人传送到不同的位置。

source: When activated, this device will "come alive" and guard the user.
target: 启动后，这件装置会“活过来”，保护使用者。

source: When blown, this instrument forces all magically summoned creatures within hearing range back to their original realm.
target: 当吹响时，这个乐器会迫使所有在听觉范围内的魔法召唤生物回到原来的领域。

source: When blown, this sinister artifact emits a weird resonance which corrupts the psyche of all those within hearing range (excluding the horn blower) - causing them to consider all other creatures with intense hatred and distrust.
target: 当吹响时，这件邪恶的神器会发出一种奇怪的共鸣，这种共鸣会腐蚀所有在听觉范围内的人的心灵（不包括吹号者）——导致他们对所有其他生物抱有强烈的仇恨和不信任。

source: When casting a spell, you will get a warning if the spell could potentially drain all your remaining Spirit. You can then press y/n to attempt casting or abort. Casting the spell in this situation is a gamble with death.
target: 施法可能耗尽剩余精神值时，游戏会发出警告。此时你可以按 y/n 继续施法或取消；在这种情况下施法无异于赌命。

source: When casting the spell, select a seen object to control within the maximum distance.
target: 施法时，选择一个可见的物体来控制在最大距离内。

source: When focused, spells are also cast at a higher skill level, and the duration to regain the focused state is reduced to 75-100 turns.
target: 专注时，法术也会以更高技能等级施放；恢复专注状态所需时间缩短至75至100回合。

source: When it goes ethereal you can't attack it, and vice versa. It can slice you with its sickle. It can also use the sickle to project evil spirits at you, though it prefers melee.
target: 它化为以太形态时你无法攻击它，反之亦然。它能用镰刀砍你，也会挥动镰刀将恶灵投向你，但更偏好近战。

source: When thrown at a living (non-undead) creature, this powder causes paralyzation.
target: 当向活体（非不死）生物投掷时，这种粉末会导致麻痹。

source: When various disturbing events occur, the shock value rises. When shock hits 100%, the following happens:
target: 发生各种令人不安的事件时，震慑值会升高。当震慑达到100%时，会发生以下情况：

target: 当缺乏 Mi-Go 所使用的特殊能量源的生物使用时，这种武器会从使用者的生命力中汲取能量（

source: When you stay out of an aware monster's vision for a certain number of turns (and nothing else alerts it), it will "forget" about you. The number of turns this takes depends on the monster; A simple animal may only care for a couple of turns after it loses sight, while a human will remain aware longer.
target: 当你连续若干回合不在已警觉怪物的视野中（且没有其他事情引起它注意），它就会“忘记”你。所需回合数取决于怪物；普通动物失去视野后可能只在意几回合，人类则会记得更久。

source: Whenever a hostile spell is blocked due to spell resistance, it is also reflected. The number of turns to regain spell resistance is halved.
target: 每当敌对法术因法术抗力而被阻挡时，它也会被反射。恢复法术抗力的回合数减半。

source: Which extra trait do you start with?
target: 开局时额外获得哪个特质？

source: While frenzied, you are immune to wounds, and your claw attacks cause fear
target: 狂乱期间，你免疫创伤，爪击还会造成恐惧

source: Whispers of arcane incantations revealing hidden lore.
target: 揭示隐秘传说的奥术咒语低语。

source: Whispers of unearthly technologies hidden beneath the Earth's surface.
target: 地表之下藏着非人科技的低语。

source: Wielded by rulers in ancient times, this powerful artifact holds power over those that were once bound to it. Any mummy beholding the owner will eventually be converted (10% chance per turn while the weapon is carried).
target: 这件强大的神器由古代统治者所使用，对那些曾经受其束缚的人拥有力量。任何看到主人的木乃伊最终都会被转化（携带武器时每回合 10% c 机会）。
自史前时代起就被使用。

source: Will use path from SDL_GetPrefPath for user data
target: Will use path from SDL_GetPrefPath for user data

source: Will use path in game directory for user data
target: Will use path in game directory for user data

source: Winning is not necessarily the sole purpose of Infra Arcana - there is also challenge to be found in exploring further, gaining more abilities, discovering more items, or encountering stranger and more powerful monsters than in previous attempts.
target: 《Infra Arcana》的目的不一定只有获胜——继续探索、获得更多能力、发现更多物品，或遇见比以往尝试中更奇异、更强大的怪物，也同样充满挑战。

source: With five feeble senses we pretend to comprehend the boundlessly complex cosmos, yet other beings might not only see very differently, but might see and study whole worlds of matter, energy, and life which lie close at hand yet can never be detected with the senses we have.
target: 我们凭借五种孱弱的感官，妄图理解无边无际而复杂至极的宇宙；然而其他存在或许不仅拥有截然不同的视觉，还能看见并研究近在咫尺的整个物质、能量与生命世界，而这些都超出了我们感官所能探测的范围。

source: Yog-Sothoth knows the gate. Yog-Sothoth is the gate. Yog-Sothoth is the key and guardian of the gate. Past, present, future, all are one in Yog-Sothoth. He knows where the Old Ones broke through of old, and where They shall break through again.
target: 犹格·索托斯知晓门。犹格·索托斯即是门。犹格·索托斯是门的钥匙与守护者。过去、现在与未来，在犹格·索托斯身上合而为一。祂知道古神昔日从何处破界而出，也知道祂们将再次从何处降临。

source: You are always aware of nearby creatures
target: 你总能察觉附近的生物

source: You can learn spells by casting them from manuscripts. Casting spells "naturally" (without manuscripts) will drain some of your spirit.
target: 你可以通过施放手稿中的法术来学习法术。无需手稿而“自然”施法会消耗一些精神值。

source: You can light the fuse, and you can wait with the lit dynamite in hands if you want. When you throw it, it can bounce off walls. When the fuse runs out the dynamite explodes for massive area damage.
target: 你可以点燃引线，也可以手持点燃的炸药等待。投出后，炸药可能会从墙上弹开。引线燃尽时，炸药会爆炸并造成大范围高额伤害。

source: You cannot become confused, the number of remaining turns for status effects are displayed
target: 你不会陷入困惑；状态效果剩余回合数会显示出来

source: You cannot become diseased, only half your wounds count, rounded down (i.e. number of wounds are halved when calculating combat, hit point and regeneration penalties, slower walking speed happens at 6 wounds instead of 3, and you die from 10 wounds instead of 5)
target: 你不会患病，创伤计数减半并向下取整（也就是说，计算战斗、生命值和恢复惩罚时创伤数量减半；达到6处创伤而非3处时行走速度才会变慢；受到10处而非5处创伤才会死亡）

source: You cannot become terrified, +10% mental shock resistance
target: 你不会陷入恐惧，精神震慑抗性提高10%

target: 用爪攻击时，偶尔会吞食活的受害者

target: 每三回合恢复1点生命值

source: You tend to find more items
target: 你通常能找到更多物品

target: 近战攻击有60%几率令目标生物虚弱2至3回合（近战伤害减半）
